interpretation_gold: An assertion of non-dependence on a supposedly higher authority.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ajá wéré-wéré ní ńpa ikún.
english_literal: It is an agile dog that kills a squirrel.
interpretation_gold: The world belongs to the quick.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àyè kì í há adìẹ kó má dèé ìdí àba-a rẹ̀.
english_literal: The space is never so tight that a chicken will not be able to reach its incubating nest.
interpretation_gold: No obstacle should keep one from one's duty.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àkótán ni gẹ̀gẹ̀ ńkó ọ̀fun.
english_literal: It is completely that goitre takes over the throat.
interpretation_gold: Calamities give no quarter.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Adùn-ún tán lára aṣọ ogóje; a nà án han ẹni méje; a bẹ̀ ẹ́ wò a rí iná méje; ó di ọjọ́ keje ó fàya.
english_literal: One's delight in a cloth costing a hundred and forty cowries is over; one spreads it out to show to seven people, one finds seven lice, and on the seventh day it is torn.
interpretation_gold: One gets what one pays for.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: A kì í dá ẹ̀rù okó ńlá ba arúgbó.
english_literal: One should not attempt to scare an old “woman” with a huge penis.
interpretation_gold: A person who has seen everything is not easily frightened.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ajá tó máa rún ọkà á láyà; ológbò to máa jẹ àkèré á ki ojú bọ omi.
english_literal: A dog that will chew dried corn must be brave; a cat that will eat a frog will dip its face in water.
interpretation_gold: It takes a great effort to accomplish a great feat.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àpọntán kò wí pé kí odò má sun.
english_literal: Scooping a spring dry does not stop more water from collecting.
interpretation_gold: If one's resources are limitless, some use will not exhaust them.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àjùmọ̀bí ò kan ti àrùn;kí alápá mú apá-a rẹ̀ kó le.
english_literal: Familial obligations do not extend to diseases; let each person look well to his or her arms.
interpretation_gold: Relatives will not bear one's disease for one.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àgbẹ̀ gbóko róṣù.
english_literal: A farmer remains on the farm and sees the moon.
interpretation_gold: The conscientious farmer spends long periods on the farm; persistence in the key to success.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: A kì í walẹ̀ fún adìẹ jẹ.
english_literal: One does not scratch the ground for the chicken to find food.
interpretation_gold: Each person is responsible for his/her own welfare.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Apá lará; ìgbọ̀nwọ́ niyèkan.
english_literal: One's arms are one's relatives; one's elbows are one's siblings by the same mother.
interpretation_gold: Even more reliable than one's relatives and siblings are one's own resources.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àro-ó pẹ́ lóko, kò tún mọ ìlù-ú lù.
english_literal: Àro stayed so long on the farm that he forgot how to beat the drum.
interpretation_gold: If one neglects one's specialty long enough, one becomes incompetent at it.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ara-à mí gba òtútù, ó gba ọ̀nini.
english_literal: My body can endure chills, and can endure coldness.
interpretation_gold: I am long-suffering.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àkèekèé rìn tapó-tapó.
english_literal: The scorpion travels accompanied by venom.
interpretation_gold: The stalwart is never unprepared to answer a call.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ajá ilé ò mọdẹ-ẹ́ ṣe.
english_literal: A domesticated dog does not know how to hunt.
interpretation_gold: Pampering kills initiative.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àṣírí ìkokò, ajá kọ́ ni yó tùú u.
english_literal: The secrets of the hyena's being will not be revealed through the actions of the dog.
interpretation_gold: The stalwart's comeuppance will not come at the hands of a no-account person.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àríṣe làríkà.
english_literal: Having an opportunity to act is also having an opportunity to tell stories.
interpretation_gold: Whoever accomplishes something worthwhile has a story to tell.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àṣá ò lè balẹ̀ kó gbéwúrẹ́.
english_literal: The kite cannot swoop down and carry off a goat.
interpretation_gold: Whoever attempts the impossible deceives him/herself.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àgbàrá kọ́ ni yó gbèé omi lọ.
english_literal: It is not the flood that will make away with the river.
interpretation_gold: The upstart cannot prevail against the well-established person.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Abẹ́rẹ́ á lọ kí ọ̀nà okùn tó dí.
english_literal: The needle will pass before the way of the thread is blocked.
interpretation_gold: Unlike the thread's, the passage of the needle through the cloth is ever smooth.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: A pa ẹmọ́ lóko ilá, a jù ú sí ọ̀kẹ́ ìlasa; ilé ẹmọ́ lẹmọ́ lọ.
english_literal: A giant rat is killed on an okra farm and thrown it into a sack containing okra leaves; the giant rat has arrived at its home.
interpretation_gold: The resourceful person will find a way to adapt to any situation.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àgbà tí kò tó ọmọdé-é rán níṣẹ́ ní ńsọ pé kó bu omi wá ká jo mú.
english_literal: It is an elder who lacks the authority to send a child on an errand who tells the child to go fetch water so they could drink it together.
interpretation_gold: If one was sure of one's authority one would not need to sweeten one's orders with incentives.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: A-jókò-ó-kunkun ò jẹ́ kí a-jókòó-jẹ́jẹ́ ó jókòo.
english_literal: The sit-tight person denies the tentative sitter a place.
interpretation_gold: The meek will not inherit the earth.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àràbà ńlá fojú di àáké.
english_literal: The huge sik-cotton tree belittles the axe.
interpretation_gold: It takes a mighty person to defy a powerful force.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àṣá wọ̀bọ kò rọ́wọ́ gbé e.
english_literal: The kite watches the monkey but has no hands to carry it off.
interpretation_gold: A monkey is no prey to a kite.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àjẹgbé nigún ńjẹbọ.
english_literal: Eating without adverse effects is the vulture's way of consuming sacrificial offerings.
interpretation_gold: Some people can engage in daring and dangerous behavior with impunity.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: A kì í fi ojú olójú ṣòwò ká jèrè.
english_literal: One never trades with other people's eyes and profit.
interpretation_gold: There is nothing like attending oneself to one's own business.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: A kì í ṣe ọ̀tẹ̀ eranko gán-ń-gán; bí a bá he ìgbín àdá là ńnà á.
english_literal: One does not conduct one's feud with an animal in a half-hearted manner; if one finds a snail one hits it with a matchet.
interpretation_gold: Give your all to every enterprise you embark upon.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àlejò orí ni kókó.
english_literal: The lump is only the head's visitor.
interpretation_gold: One should learn to live with afflictions.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: A kì í fi ojúbọ́rọ́ gba ọmọ lọ́wọ́ èkùrọ́.
english_literal: One does not easily or casually take the child from the palm-nut.
interpretation_gold: It takes effort to accomplish a good end.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: A-lèjà-má-lè-jà-pẹ́, ẹlẹgbẹ́ ojo.
english_literal: He-who-can-fight-but-cannot-fight-for-long, the equal of a coward.
interpretation_gold: Ability to start a fight is nothing like the ability to see it through.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àkànṣe lọfà ìmàdò; jagan oró ò ran èse.
english_literal: The arrow for a warthog is a major project; an ordinary poison has no effect on the cat.
interpretation_gold: Certain tasks call for deliberate and extraordinary efforts.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àìdúró là ńpè níjó.
english_literal: Not standing still is what is described as dancing.
interpretation_gold: Continuous striving deserves praise, whatever the outcome.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Akíkanjú-kankan, ogun ní ńlọ;abùwàwà, ọjà ní ńná; àkànní òbúkọ, bó bá tòṣì a máa rí jẹ.
english_literal: For the exceptionally brave person the proper profession is warring; for the gregarious person, trading; the illustrious he-goat, even when it is poor, finds enough to eat.
interpretation_gold: Proper application of one's talent makes one prosper.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àgbólà ni tàgbọ̀nrín; ọjọ́ tí àgbọ̀nrín bá gbó ni ọjọ́ ikú-u rẹ̀ ńyẹ̀.
english_literal: Baying-and-surviving is the fate of the deer; whenever a deer bays, on that day its death is averted.
interpretation_gold: Every reverse portends good fortune in the end.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àdán tó sùn sídìí ọsàn ò rí he, áḿbọ̀sì oódẹ tó ní òún jí dé.
english_literal: Bat, who slept by the orange tree, found no orange to pick, let alone parrot who said it came over very early at dawn.
interpretation_gold: The more persistent person will surely be rewarded before the less persistent.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àkèekèé ní òún kúrò ní kòkòrò-o kí nìyí?
english_literal: Scorpion says that its status transcends what-type-of-insect-is-this?
interpretation_gold: Stature and importance are not always commensurate; some people should not be under-estimated.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Alákatam̀pò ojú ò lè ta ẹran pa.
english_literal: A person with cross-bows in his eyes cannot kill an animal.
interpretation_gold: The most vicious of looks cannot kill.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Àgbàtán ni gẹ̀gẹ̀ńgba ọ̀fun.
english_literal: It is completely that goitre takes over the neck.
interpretation_gold: One cannot stop matters from running their course.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí ojú kò pọ́nni bí osùn, a kì í he ohun pupa bí idẹ.
english_literal: If one's eyes do not become as red as camwood stain, one does not come by something as red as brass.
interpretation_gold: Unless one endures some hardship, one does not reap great benefits.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí iwájú ò bá ṣeé lọ sí, ẹ̀hìn a ṣeé padà sí.
english_literal: If one cannot go forward, one will be able to retreat.
interpretation_gold: If a goal proves impossible of achievement, one can at least abandon it.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: “Bí mo lè kú ma kú” lọmọkùrín fi ńlágbárá “Ng ò lè wáá kú” lọmọkùnrín fi ńlẹ.
english_literal: “If I must die let me die” is what makes a man strong; “I simply will not court death” is what makes a man lazy or cowardly.
interpretation_gold: Daring makes the man; caution unmakes the man.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí ẹrú yó bàá jẹ ìfun, ibi ẹ̀dọ̀ ní-í tí ḿbẹ̀rẹ̀.
english_literal: A slave that would eat intestines must begin with the liver.
interpretation_gold: One must endure unpleasantness before achieving one's ends.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí màlúù-ú tó màlúù, ọ̀pá kan ni Fúlàní fi ńdà wọ́n.
english_literal: However numerous the cattle might be, it is with only one staff that the Fulbe man herds them.
interpretation_gold: The good worksperson needs no elaborate tools.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí ilẹ̀-ẹ́ bá mọ́, ojú orun lọ̀lẹ ńwà.
english_literal: When day breaks the lazy person will still be asleep.
interpretation_gold: Lazy people will not rouse themselves to do an honest day's work.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí ìṣẹ́ bá ńṣẹ́ ọ̀dọ́ láṣẹ̀ẹ́jù, kó lọ sígbó erin; bó bá pa erin ìṣẹ́-ẹ rẹ̀ a tán; bí erín bá pá a, ìṣẹ́-ẹ rẹ̀ a tán.
english_literal: If a youth is in the grips of excessive privations, he should go after an elephant; if he kills an elephant his privations will be over; if an elephant kills him, his privations will be over.
interpretation_gold: People in desperate straights should resort to desperate remedies; whatever the outcome, they will be no worse off than before.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí a bá ńpa èpo oṣè, ṣe ní ḿmáaá sanra sí i.
english_literal: The more one peels the bark of the baobab, the fatter it becomes.
interpretation_gold: The more a certain person is misused, the more successful he/she becomes.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí ojú owó ẹni ò yóni, ènì ò lè yóni.
english_literal: If what one bought for one's money does not fill one, the little extra thrown into the bargain will not.
interpretation_gold: A person who cannot survive on his main occupation cannot survive on his sideline.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí iná kò bá tán láṣọ, ẹ̀jẹ̀ kì í tán léèékánná.
english_literal: If lice are not completely gone from one's clothings, one's nails will not be free of blood.
interpretation_gold: If the causes of one's problems are not removed, the problems will persist.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí ẹnìkan ò kíni “Kú-ù-jokòó,” kíkí Ọlọ́run-ún ju ti igba èèyàn lọ.
english_literal: If a person does not extend greetings to one, God's greetings are worth more than two hundred peoples'.
interpretation_gold: Being snubbed by people matters nothing, as long as God does not snub one.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí ẹ̀yá bá dẹkùn, ẹran ní ńpajẹ.
english_literal: When the cub becomes a grown leopard, it kills animals for food.
interpretation_gold: When the child becomes an adult, he adopts adult ways.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí ó pẹ́ títí, àlejò á di onílé.
english_literal: In time, a sojourner becomes a native.
interpretation_gold: Persistence leads to success.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí ó pẹ́ títí, akólòlò á pe baba.
english_literal: However long it may take, the stammarer will eventually say, “Father.”
interpretation_gold: With perseverance, the most difficult task will eventually be accomplished.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí ìbí bá tẹ̀, bí ìbí bá wọ́, oníkálukú a máa ṣe baba nílé ara-a rẹ̀.
english_literal: If the pedigree is bent, if the pedigree is crooked, each person will play the father in his own home.
interpretation_gold: In difficult times, each person has the solace and security of his own home.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí a kò bá jìyà tó kún agbọ̀n; a ò lè jẹ oore tó kún ahá.
english_literal: If one does not experience enough suffering to fill a basket, one cannot enjoy enough good to fill a cup.
interpretation_gold: Suffering precedes pleasures.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí ebí bá ńpa ọ̀lẹ, à jẹ́ kó kú.
english_literal: If a lazy person is suffering from hunger, he/she should be left to die.
interpretation_gold: Shiftless people deserve no sympathy.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí ọwọ́ kò sin ilẹ̀, tí kò sin ẹnu, ayo ní ńjẹ́.
english_literal: If the hand does not cease going down and going to the mouth, satiation results.
interpretation_gold: If one keeps at a task, it will eventually be accomplished.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí ẹkẹ́-ẹ tálákà ò tó lówùúrọ̀, á tó lálẹ́.
english_literal: If a poor person's forked stake is not long enough in the morning, it will be long enough at night.
interpretation_gold: The things one rejects when the choice is abundant will become acceptable when there is no choice.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Bí ó ti wuni là ńṣe ìmàle ẹni; bó wu Lèmámù a fẹlẹ́dẹ̀ jẹ sààrì.
english_literal: One practices one's Islam as one pleases; if the Imam wishes he may break his fast with pork.
interpretation_gold: One lives one's life as one sees best.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Díẹ̀-díẹ̀ lẹyẹ ńmu ọsàn.
english_literal: It is bit by bit that a bird eats an orange.
interpretation_gold: Easy does it.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Dùndún fọ̀ràn gbogbo ṣàpamọ́ra.
english_literal: The talking drum endures all matters without complaint.
interpretation_gold: It is best to be stoically resilient.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Díẹ̀-díẹ̀ leku ńjawọ.
english_literal: It is bit by bit that rats eat leather.
interpretation_gold: With slow and steady application, even a difficult task will be done.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Dídán lẹyẹlé ńdán kú.
english_literal: A perpetually shining appearance is what chracterizes the pigeon even until death.
interpretation_gold: An observation that a person's reputation cannot be tarnished, or a wish that it never be tarnished.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Dídán là ńdán ọ̀ràn wò; bí olówó ẹní kú, à lọ ṣúpó.
english_literal: One should give everything a try; if one's owner dies one goes to claim his wife.
interpretation_gold: One should attempt even the impossible.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Díẹ̀-díẹ̀ ní ńtánṣẹ́.
english_literal: Gradual efforts complete a task.
interpretation_gold: The biggest task is accomplished with gradual and steady attention.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ewu iná kì í pa àwòdì.
english_literal: The African black kite is never killed in a brushfire emergency.
interpretation_gold: The bird is beyond any harm the fire might do.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ebè kan ṣoṣo àkùrọ́ kúrò ní “Mo fẹ́rẹ̀ẹ́ ṣíwọ́.”
english_literal: A single heap on the farm does not warrant “I am just about done.”
interpretation_gold: The first step is not nearly the completion of a long journey.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Eṣú jẹ oko tán eṣù lọ; eṣú lọ Wata, ilé-e rẹ̀.
english_literal: The locusts are done feeding, the locusts have departed; the locusts have gone to Wata, their home.
interpretation_gold: When one's task is completed, one returns to one's home. Or, The marauder has done his damage and has returned to where he came from.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Eégún tí ńjẹ orí ẹṣin, orí àgbò ò lè kò ó láyà.
english_literal: The masquerader who is accustomed to eating horse heads will not be daunted by ram heads.
interpretation_gold: A person who has faced down serious challenges will not be defeated by a slight inconvenience.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ebi ò jẹ́ ká pa ọwọ́ mọ́; ebí ṣenú papala.
english_literal: Hunger keeps one from folding one's hands; hunger causes the mouth “or cheeks” to shrink.
interpretation_gold: One must work in order to eat.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Èébú kì í so.
english_literal: Insults do not attach to one's body like pods.
interpretation_gold: Insult ignored is insult defused.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Eṣinṣín ńpọntí; ekòló ńṣú ọ̀lẹ̀lẹ̀; kantí-kantí ní ká wá ǹkan dí agbè lẹ́nu kí ǹkankan má kòó sí i.
english_literal: The fly is procuring wine while the worm is cooking bean-meal, and the sugar-fly asks them to find something to cork the gourd so nothing would enter into it.
interpretation_gold: The idler seeks to find more work for those already fully and usefully employed.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Erín jẹ̀ jẹ̀ jẹ̀ kò fọwọ́ kọ́ aṣá; ẹfọ̀nọ́n jẹ̀ jẹ̀ jẹ̀ kò ki ẹsẹ̀ wọ pòòlò; ẹyẹ kékèké ńfò lókè wọn ò forí gbági.
english_literal: The elephant forages a long time without cutting its hand on a spear; the buffalo forages a long time without falling into a trap; numerous small birds fly across the sky without colliding with trees.
interpretation_gold: Despite the ubiquitousness of danger, one will be safe.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Èpò ìbúlẹ̀ kì í pa irẹ́.
english_literal: Creeping weeds cannot kill the silk rubber tree.
interpretation_gold: A puny person is no threat to a mighty person.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Èèwọ̀ ni tọwọ̀; a kì í figi ọwọ̀ dáná.
english_literal: As far as the broom is concerned it is taboo: one does not make kindling of broomsticks.
interpretation_gold: Come what may, a threatening or threatened disaster will not happen.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ewúro ò fi tojo korò.
english_literal: The bitter-leaf did not become bitter as a result of cowardice.
interpretation_gold: One does what one must, regardless of the actions or wishes of others.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Error does not await the king before it dons a crown; Ogunṣọṣẹ
interpretation_gold: Native genius needs no external cultivation.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Èdì kì í mú ọjọ́ kó má là.
english_literal: No charm can act upon the day and keep it from dawning.
interpretation_gold: What is inevitable will come to pass, willy-nilly.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Èkó ilá gba ara ẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ ọ̀bẹ.
english_literal: Okro that has gone fibrous has delivered itself from the knife.
interpretation_gold: At some point, one outgrows some dangers.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Èpè ìlasa kì í ja àgbọ̀nrín.
english_literal: The curses of okro leaves do not affect the deer.
interpretation_gold: One cannot be at risk for what one cannot help doing.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Èpè ìbínú ò pa odì.
english_literal: An angry curse does not kill an enemy.
interpretation_gold: One gets only psychological satisfaction from cursing one's enemy.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ewúrẹ́ ò lè rí ewé ọdán òkè fi ṣe nǹkan.
english_literal: A goat can in no wise take the fig tree's leaves aloft for any purpose.
interpretation_gold: Certain people are beyond the reach of some people's machinations.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Èèyàn ìbáà kúrú, ìbáà búrẹ́wà, gbèsè ò sí, ìtìjú ò sí.
english_literal: Whether a person be short or ugly, if there is no debt, there can be no disgrace.
interpretation_gold: As long as one is debt-free other details of one's personal circumstances are of little consequence.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Èminrin ńjẹni, kò tó ìyà.
english_literal: Being bothered by sandflies is no misfortune.
interpretation_gold: Whatever one's problems, they can always be worse.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ebi ni yó kọ̀ọ́ wèrè lọ́gbọ́n.
english_literal: It is hunger that will force sense into the imbecile.
interpretation_gold: Even an imbecile must heed hunger.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ebí ńpa ejò, ahún ńyan.
english_literal: The snake is hungry, and the tortoise saunters by.
interpretation_gold: If one is invulnerable, one may strut.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ewúrẹ́ ńṣọdún, àgùtán gbàlù sẹ́hìn, òbúkọ-ọ́ ní ká sin òun lọ sílé àna òun.
english_literal: The goat is celebrating an event, the sheep is in a procession with drums, and the he-goat asks to be accompanied to its in-law's home.
interpretation_gold: A person who has made no investment should not expect to reap the benefits of the venture.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Fífẹ́ la fẹ́ ẹ̀fọ́ tí à ńpè-é ní ọ̀rẹ́ ẹ̀kọ ti ilé oge-é tó oge-é jẹ.
english_literal: It is only because one loves spinach that one calls it a friend of corn loaf; what the dandy has at home is enough food for him or her.
interpretation_gold: That one delights in another person's company is not to say that one cannot do without it.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: “Fọ́ ẹ̀kọ ká jọ mu ú,” kò tó ọkọlóbìnrin-ín ṣe ni.
english_literal: “Prepare the corn pap and let us eat it together” is an indication that the speaker lacks what it takes to be a husband.
interpretation_gold: One should not be tentative in exercising one's authority.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Fi gọ̀gọ̀ sílẹ̀ fún ọ̀dáwé; fi ọkọ sílẹ̀ fún onílara.
english_literal: Leave the hooked stick alone for the leaf plucker; leave the husband alone for the jealous woman.
interpretation_gold: If a person will nor share what he or she has, one should simply shun him or her.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Gbẹ́dó-gbẹ́dó kan ò lè fi ọ̀gẹ̀dẹ̀ ṣe nǹkan.
english_literal: No carver of mortars can do a thing to the banana stem.
interpretation_gold: Certain people and certain objects have nothing to fear from certain types of adversaries.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìgbà yí làárọ̀? Arúgbó ńṣoge.
english_literal: Is it just morning now? The old person is grooming himself/herself.
interpretation_gold: Never wait until it is too late before you look to your well being.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Igúnnugún pa guuru mádìẹ; kò leè gbe.
english_literal: The vulture rushes at the chicken, but it cannot carry it off.
interpretation_gold: One should not attempt what one knows one cannot accomplish.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìwòyí èṣí ewùrà-a baba-à mí ti ta; ìrègún rere ò sí níbẹ̀.
english_literal: “By this time last year my father's water-yam had grown huge”; that is nothing good to reminisce about.
interpretation_gold: One should look to the present instead of dwelling on past achievements, and others' at that.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìjẹkújẹ kì í pa ahanrandi.
english_literal: Careless eating does not kill the worm ahanrandi.
interpretation_gold: One can do what one pleases without fear of repercussion.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Iṣu ẹni kì í fini pe ọmọdé kó má ta.
english_literal: One's yam will not because one is only a youth refuse to grow to maturity.
interpretation_gold: Even a youth can accomplish much if he/she makes an effort.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ire tí ọwọ́-ọ̀ mi ò tó, ma fi gọ̀ǹgọ̀ fà á.
english_literal: The good my hand cannot reach, I will pull down with a hooked stick.
interpretation_gold: I will spare no effort in pursuit of my goals.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìlẹ̀kẹ̀ ọ̀pọ̀lọ́ ò yí olè lójú.
english_literal: Frogs' eggs do not attract the attention of the thief.
interpretation_gold: If one has nothing for others to covet, one is safe from envy.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Iná kì í jó kí ògiri sá.
english_literal: Fire does not rage and cause a wall to flee.
interpretation_gold: Certain entities are invulnerable to certain dangers.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìṣẹ́ ò gbẹ́kún, ebí jàre ọ̀lẹ.
english_literal: Destitution does not yield to tears; hunger has a claim on the shiftless.
interpretation_gold: One does not end one's destitution by simple lamentation; whoever does not work is a fair victim to hunger.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Idà kì í lọ kídà má bọ̀.
english_literal: The sword never departs without returning.
interpretation_gold: Said in the context of a prayer that a person departing on a journey might return safely.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìríkúrìí kì í fọ́ ojú.
english_literal: Evil sights do not make the eyes go blind.
interpretation_gold: There is nothing in the offing that one cannot withstand.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìgbà yí làárọ̀? Arúgbó ńkọgba.
english_literal: Is it just morning now? The old man is striving to make two hundred heaps a day.
interpretation_gold: The efforts that would have been commendable if timely are now worthless.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Iṣu àtẹnumọ́ kì í jóná; ọ̀kà àtẹnumọ́ kì í mẹrẹ; àwòdì kì í gbé adìẹ à-tẹnu-kunkun-mọ́.
english_literal: The yam one does not stop speaking about will not get burnt; the corn-meal one speaks constantly about does not become too well-done; a chicken that is the subject of constant caution does not get snatched up by a hawk.
interpretation_gold: Anything that is the subject of constant attention will not be ruined.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìpilẹ̀ ọrọ̀-ọ́ lẹ́gbin.
english_literal: The beginning of wealth is chock-full of filth.
interpretation_gold: Success comes after great effort and much headache.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìdẹra ò kan àgbà.
english_literal: Ease has nothing to do with age.
interpretation_gold: Industry pays off more surely than longevity.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìjà ò mọ ẹ̀gbọ́n, ó sọ àbúrò dakin.
english_literal: Fighting knows not who is the elder; it makes a hero of the younger.
interpretation_gold: In certain situations, prowess is more important than age.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Iná kì í jó kó wọlé akàn.
english_literal: A fire does not rage and enter the home of the crab.
interpretation_gold: An incantatory observation invoking immunity for a person from some danger.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìsàlẹ̀ ọrọ̀-ọ́ lẹ́gbin.
english_literal: The dregs of wealth is filthy.
interpretation_gold: Wealth comes only after one has endured a great deal of rubbish.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ilá kì í ga ju akórè lọ kó má tẹ̀ ẹ́ ká.
english_literal: The okro plant is never so much taller than the harvester that he/she cannot bend it to harvest.
interpretation_gold: The conscientious worker will always find the means to complete his/her task.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìlẹ̀kẹ̀-ẹ́ gbé orí àtẹ wu ọ̀lẹ.
english_literal: Beads remain on the display tray and from there attract the admiration of the feckless person.
interpretation_gold: The feckless person can only admire desirable things, but will not have the means to purchase them.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìlérí adìẹ, asán ni lójú àwòdì.
english_literal: The chicken's boasts are unavailing before the kite.
interpretation_gold: The puny person who threatens a formidable person fools him/herself.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Igba ẹranko kì í dènà de ẹkùn.
english_literal: Two hundred animals will not lie in ambush for a leopard.
interpretation_gold: One should exercise prudence and realize when an adversary is more than a match for one.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Igbe kí-ni-ngó-jẹ-sùn ní ḿpọ̀lẹ.
english_literal: The cry “What shall I eat for supper?” is what kills the lazy person.
interpretation_gold: The lazy person will rather put his/her efforts into lamenting his/her fate than into gainful employment.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìje òun oore ní ḿmú ọmọ ṣiṣẹ́.
english_literal: Competition and reward are the inducements for a child to work hard.
interpretation_gold: It is the wish to at least keep up with others or the hope for a reward that makes one work hard.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ibi gbogbo nilẹ̀ ọ̀wọ̀.
english_literal: Every place deserves to be treated with respect and reverence.
interpretation_gold: Decorous behavior is not for certain occasions only.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìrọ́jú ni ohun gbogbo; ojoojúmọ́ ní ńrẹni.
english_literal: Perseverance is everything; one gets tired daily.
interpretation_gold: One should not fold up in the face of the first trial.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìkòkò tí yó jẹ ata, ìdí ẹ̀ á gbóná.
english_literal: The pot that wishes to eat pepper (stew) will first endure a scalded bottom.
interpretation_gold: Good things come only after great labor or suffering.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Isán ḿbọ́jú, ìtàlá ńwẹsẹ̀.
english_literal: Nine days wash the face, thirteen days wash the feet.
interpretation_gold: Said of a person who takes eternity to do simple things.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ọ̀gẹrọ̀ lọ̀lẹ́ mọ̀-ọ́ ṣe; kò jẹ́ wá iṣẹ́ agbára.
english_literal: The lazy person knows how to do only things that call for little effort; he/she never seeks out work that demands strength.
interpretation_gold: Said of those who always seek the easiest way out of a dilemma.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ilé tí a tó lọ sùn lọ́sàn-án, a kì í tó òru lọ sùn ún.
english_literal: A house one has the right to sleep in during the day, one does not wait for the cover of night to go sleep in it.
interpretation_gold: One should not be coy about doing what one has the right to do.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìyáwọ́, ìyásẹ̀ lajá fi ńpa ehoro; wàrà-wàrà lẹkùn ńgùn.
english_literal: Nimble hands and nimble feet make it possible for a dog to kill a rabbit; the leopard attacks its prey with lightning speed.
interpretation_gold: One should be brisk about what one has to do.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìṣẹ́ ńṣẹ́ ọ ò ńrojú; ta ni yó fùn-ún ọ ni oògùn-un rẹ̀?
english_literal: Destitution grips you and you sit scowling; who will give you the antidote?
interpretation_gold: One should take practical steps to solve one's problem rather than sit around moping.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìyànjú là ńgbà; bí a ò gbìyànjú bí ọ̀lẹ là ńrí; ojoojúmọ́ ní ńrẹni.
english_literal: One simply makes an effort; if one does not make an effort one seems like a shiftless person; one copes with weariness daily.
interpretation_gold: In spite of weariness, one must still make a decent effort at one's calling.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìrèké ti ládùn látọ̀run.
english_literal: The sugar-cane came with its sweetness from heaven.
interpretation_gold: An illustrious person's qualities are native, not conferred by admirers.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Iṣẹ́ loògùn ìṣẹ́.
english_literal: Work is the antidote for destitution.
interpretation_gold: One must work in order to better one's condition.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìròjú baba ọ̀lẹ.
english_literal: Shirking work “is the” father of laziness.
interpretation_gold: The person who will not work is worse than a lazy person.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ilé tí a tóó kun, a kì í bo ìtùfù-u rẹ̀.
english_literal: A house one is in a position to burn, one does not conceal the torch to set it ablaze.
interpretation_gold: One need not be coy in doing what one has the authority or standing to do.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Igba eṣinṣin kì í dènà de ọwọ̀.
english_literal: Two hundred flies will not lie in ambush for a broom.
interpretation_gold: Despite their number, one's adversaries are no match for one.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ikán ò lè rí ṣe lára ìgànná.
english_literal: The termite can have no adverse effect on a wall.
interpretation_gold: Certain things are invulnerable to certain disasters.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìgbé a gbé ìyàwó kò ṣéé gbé owó.
english_literal: The strategy one adopts in acquiring a wife will not do with regard to money.
interpretation_gold: What suffices in a certain situation may not be applicable in another.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Igi kì í dá lóko kó pa ará ilé.
english_literal: A tree does not snap in the forest and kill a person at home.
interpretation_gold: Disaster cannot befall a person who is not in an exposed position.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìkọ́ kì í kọ́ ejò lẹ́sẹ̀.
english_literal: A snare never catches a snake in the leg.
interpretation_gold: One will remain invulnerable to any danger.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Iṣẹ́-ajé-ò-gbé-bòji, ọmọ ẹ̀ Òjíkùtù.
english_literal: Gainful-work-does-not-keep-to-the-shade; his/her child is named First-up-at-dawn.
interpretation_gold: Success in life calls for self-sacrifice.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìpọ́njú àgbẹ̀ ò ju ọdún kan.
english_literal: A farmer's suffering will not last longer than a year.
interpretation_gold: Every reversal has its end.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ibi tí a ní kí tẹ̀tẹ̀ má tẹ̀, ibẹ̀ ní ńtẹ̀.
english_literal: Wherever one orders wild spinach not to step on, there it will surely trample.
interpretation_gold: The destinies of certain people defy manipulation by adversaries.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìgbín kọ mímì ejò.
english_literal: The snail rejects the fate of being swallowed by a snake.
interpretation_gold: There are some perils to which one is immune.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìṣẹ́ ní òun ó kòówó; ìyà-á ní òun ó singbà; réderède-é ní òun ó ṣe onígbọ̀wọ́; ta ní jẹ́ rere nínú-u wọn?
english_literal: Destitution proposes to trade its services for money; suffering proposes to pawn itself for money; wretchedness proposes to stand surety for them; which of them has anything going for it?
interpretation_gold: In a community of losers no one person can be expected to turn the situation around.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ajé le, ó tó ọpa.
english_literal: Gainful employment is tough, as tough as a supple pole.
interpretation_gold: Gainful work is not easy.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Iṣú wà lọ́wọ́ ẹ; ọ̀bẹ́ wà lọ́wọ́ ẹ.
english_literal: The yam is in your hand, and the knife is in your hand.
interpretation_gold: Said to encourage one to do what he/she has to do without further delay, especially when all requisite conditions have been met.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìwà ọ̀lẹ ḿba ọ̀lẹ lẹ́rù; ọ̀lẹ́ pàdánù, ó ní aráyé ò fẹ́ràn òun.
english_literal: The lazy person's character fills him/her with fear; the lazy person loses all and complains that the world hates him/her.
interpretation_gold: Each person is more the architect of his/her own fortune than the victim of others' machinations.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìmúmúnàá abìdí sembé-sembé; ìmúmúnàá ò dáná rí, tiná-tiná ní ḿbá kiri.
english_literal: Firefly with its rear ablaze; the firefly has never kindled a fire, but it carries fire with it wherever it goes.
interpretation_gold: Said of people who want results without making any effort.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìṣẹ́ tó ṣẹ́ ọmọ lógún ọdún, ìyà tó jẹ ọmọ lọ́gbọ̀n oṣù, bí kò pa ọmọ, a sì lẹ́hìn ọmọ.
english_literal: The poverty that has plagued a child for twenty years, the suffering that has been the fate of a child for thirty months, if it does not kill the child it should leave the child in peace.
interpretation_gold: Perseverance puts an eventual end to all suffering.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìlọrin ò lóòṣà; ẹnu lòòṣà Ìlọrin.
english_literal: The Ilorin person has no god;; his/her mouth is his/her god.
interpretation_gold: The person under reference is all mouth and no substance.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ikọ̀ tí ò mọ iṣẹ́-ẹ́ jẹ́ ní ńjẹ́ ẹ lẹ́ẹ̀mejèe.
english_literal: It is the messenger who does not know how to deliver a message properly that delivers it seven times over.
interpretation_gold: Incompetence imposes additional burden on a person.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìbẹ̀rù ejò ò jẹ́ ká tẹ ọmọ ejò mọ́lẹ̀.
english_literal: Fear of the snake keeps one from stepping on the young of the snake.
interpretation_gold: One usually benefits from the stature or position of one's parents or protector.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìṣẹ́ kì í ṣe ohun àmúṣeré; ìyà kì í ṣe ohun àmúṣàwàdà.
english_literal: Destitution is not something to treat with levity; misery is nothing to joke about.
interpretation_gold: One should not trifle with one's problems.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìpẹ̀ta lọṣẹ àpọ́n.
english_literal: The sap of the violet tree is what the bachelor uses for soap.
interpretation_gold: A person who lacks the means to properly provide for himself/herself must be resourceful at making do.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ibi gbogbo ní ńrọ àdàbà lọ́rùn.
english_literal: Every place is hospitable and comfortable for the dove.
interpretation_gold: Said to mean that no circumstance will be beyond one's ability to cope.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìrònú ìkokò ní yó pa ajá.
english_literal: Worrying about the wolf is what will kill the dog.
interpretation_gold: Some people are already vanquished by the mere anticipation of a struggle.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìyà tó ńjẹ ọ̀lẹ ò kéré; a-lápá-má-ṣiṣẹ́.
english_literal: The malaise that afflicts the lazy person is not trifling; one-who-has-arms-that-will-not-work.
interpretation_gold: Laziness is a great affliction.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ìgbín kì í tẹnu mọ́gi kó má gùn ún.
english_literal: The snail will not fasten unto a tree and fail to climb it.
interpretation_gold: Once one takes on a job, one should see it through.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Jagajìgì ò mọ ogun; ogun ńpa elégbèje àdó.
english_literal: Loading the body down with charms has no effect in a war; war kills even the person carrying fourteen hundred juju gourdlets.
interpretation_gold: One should trust in one's arms rather than in one's charms.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kò sí bí igbó ṣe lè ta kókó tó, erin óò kọjá.
english_literal: No matter how knotty the bush might be, the elephant will find a way through it.
interpretation_gold: No obstacle can stop a resourceful ad formidable person.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Màrìwò ò wí fúnra wọn tẹ́lẹ̀ tí wọ́n fi ńyọ.
english_literal: Palm fronds do not consult with one another before they sprout.
interpretation_gold: Each person is responsible for his/her own decisions.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kọ̀ǹkọ̀ṣọ̀-ọ́ ní bí a ti ṣe òun tó yìí, òún ṣì ńku èlùbọ́.
english_literal: The sieve says despite all that has been done to it it still manages to sift yam-flour.
interpretation_gold: A statement that despite all vicissitudes placed in one's path one was still able to do what was expected of one.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: “Mo kúgbé” lehoro ńdún lóko; “Mo mówó rá” làparò ńdún lábà-a bàbà.
english_literal: “I have perished!” is the cry of the hare in the bush; “I have destroyed things worth a lot of money!” is the cry of the partridge in the guinea-corn field.
interpretation_gold: A worthless person can also be counted upon to destroy things of value.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kí á gbé ọkọ́ so sájà ká pète ìmẹ́lẹ́; ojúgun-ún yó tán ó fikùn sẹ́hìn.
english_literal: Hiding the hoe in the loft and contriving to shirk work; the shin ate its fill and developed a stomach at its back.
interpretation_gold: Said of people who shirk work but eagerly partake of the rewards.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kì í tán nígbá osùn ká má rìí fi pa ọmọ lára.
english_literal: The calabash of camwood is never so empty that one does not find enough in it to rub on a baby.
interpretation_gold: One may lack many things, but never the means to fulfill one's obligations.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kò sí alápatà tí ńpa igún.
english_literal: There is no butcher who slaughters the vulture for sale.
interpretation_gold: Certain actions are forbidden: one is beyond the powers of one's enemies.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Lójú-lójú là ńwo ẹni tí a óò kéwì fún.
english_literal: It is directly in the eyes that one looks at the subject of the praise poem one is performing.
interpretation_gold: One should squarely face the person with whom one has business.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kò sí èrè nínú-u “Gba owó kà.”
english_literal: There is no profit in “Take this money and count it “for me”.”
interpretation_gold: One cannot count on profiting from others' industry.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Múlele múlèle: ilá tí ò mú lele ò léè so; ikàn tí ò mú lele ò léè wẹ̀wù ẹ̀jẹ̀.
english_literal: High potency upon high potency: the okro that lacks high potency cannot fruit; the bitter tomato that lacks high potency cannot achieve the blood-red complexion.
interpretation_gold: Sharpness is a requisite quality for success.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kò sí ewu lóko, àfi gìrì àparò.
english_literal: There is no danger on the farm except for the sudden noise of partridges taking to the air.
interpretation_gold: An incantatory wish that all dangers will stay well away from one or some subject of one's wishes.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kò sí ẹni tí Ọlọ́run ò ṣe fún, àfi ẹni tó bá ní tòun ò tó.
english_literal: There is no one to whom God has not been generous, only those who will say he has not been generous enough.
interpretation_gold: Everyone has something to be thankful for.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kò sí ibi tí ọwọ́-ọ̀jà erin ò tó.
english_literal: There is no place an elephant's trunk cannot reach.
interpretation_gold: There is no place beyond a person's reach or influence.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kí ni ọmọ ẹyẹ ó ṣe fún ìyá ẹ̀ ju pé kó dàgbà kó fò lọ?
english_literal: What will a nestling do for its mother other than becoming mature and flying away?
interpretation_gold: People who are powerless to help one cannot hurt one by witholding their support from one.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kò sí ibi tí kò gba ọ̀gọ̀; ọ̀lẹ layé ò gbà.
english_literal: There is no place where a fool is not welcome; the world rejects only shiftless people.
interpretation_gold: People may be foolish, but they had better not be shiftless.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kò sí ohun tí ńti òkè bọ̀ tí ilẹ̀ ò gbà.
english_literal: There is nothing dropping from above that the earth cannot withstand.
interpretation_gold: There is no eventuality that one cannot cope with.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kò sí ikú tí kò rọ adìẹ lọ́rùn.
english_literal: There is no manner of death that is inconvenient for the chicken.
interpretation_gold: One is game for whatever propositions might be made to one.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kì í kan ẹni ká yẹrí.
english_literal: When a duty comes to one's turn one does not duck it.
interpretation_gold: One must step up and carry out one's responsibility when the time comes.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kí á ránni níṣẹ́ ò tó ká mọ̀ ọ́ jẹ́.
english_literal: To be sent on an errand is nothing compared to knowing how to carry it out.
interpretation_gold: The good servant is the one who does performs his/her tasks well.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Màrìwò ò wojú ẹnìkan, àfi Ọlọ́run.
english_literal: Palm fronds look up to no one except God.
interpretation_gold: One's trust is in God only.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Máà gbíyè lógún; ti ọwọ́ ẹni ní ńtóni.
english_literal: Place not your hopes in inheritance; the product of one's hand labor is what sustains one.
interpretation_gold: Whoever trusts in inheritance courts disaster.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kò ka ikú: àdàbà sùú-sùú tí ńjẹ̀ láàrin àṣá.
english_literal: It fears not death: the pigeon that forages among hawks.
interpretation_gold: Said of people who habitually court danger.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: “Ng ó lọ, ng ó lọ!” lobìnrín fi ńdẹ́rù ba ọkùnriń “Bóo lè lọ o lọ” lọkùnrín fi ńdẹ́rù ba obìnrin.
english_literal: “I will leave you, I will leave you!” is the threat a woman flings at a man; “If you have a mind to leave, go ahead and leave!” is the retort a man throws at a woman.
interpretation_gold: Every person in a relationship has something he/she can hold over the others.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ní inú òwú la ti ḿbù ṣènì òwú.
english_literal: It is out of one's stock of cotton that one takes some for makeweight.
interpretation_gold: It is to one's treasury that one resorts for investments to further build the treasury.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ní ọjọ́ eré nìyà ńdun ọ̀lẹ; kàkà kó wọlé kó jáde a fọwọ́ rọ igi, a pòṣé ṣàrà.
english_literal: It is on the day of festivities that the lazy person is miserable; instead of going inside his room and emerging again “in other words, fetching gifts for the revelers” he leans his arms against a tree and hisses incessantly.
interpretation_gold: Shiftless people eventually reap the disgrace of their laziness when they are unable to do what is socially expected of them.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: The labẹ́labẹ́
interpretation_gold: One may be minding one's business when one is provoked; one should nevertheless be prepared to respond.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kìnìún ò níí ṣàgbákò ẹkùn.
english_literal: A lion does not face peril from a leopard.
interpretation_gold: The stronger person has nothing to fear from the weaker.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ní inú òfíì àti ọ̀láà, ọmọ páńdọ̀rọ̀ ńgbó.
english_literal: Despite being blown hither and tither in the gale, the fruits of the sausage tree survive to maturity.
interpretation_gold: Some people will thrive despite adversities.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kí ni eégún ńwò tí kò fi òwúrọ̀ jó?
english_literal: What was the masquerader looking at that he did not take advantage of the morning to dance?
interpretation_gold: One should not dawdle, but rather do things at the most opportune moment.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kì í rẹ òòrẹ̀ kó rẹ sinsin ìdí ẹ̀.
english_literal: The porcupine may tire, but never the quills at its rear.
interpretation_gold: One can never be so tired that one will leave oneself defenseless.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kíkú ajá, ng kò ní omitooro ẹ̀-ẹ́ lá; àìkú ẹ̀ ng kò ní pè é rán níṣẹ́.
english_literal: When the dog dies I will not lick the stew made with it; alive I will not send it on an errand.
interpretation_gold: One has absolutely no use for the person at whom the proverb is directed.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Lékèélékèé gbàràdá, ó gba tẹlòmíràn mọ.
english_literal: The cattle egret borrows wonders to perform, and performs enough for itself and others.
interpretation_gold: Said of people who have done far more than anyone expected of them.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: “Má kọjá mi Olùgbàlà” kì í ṣe orin à-kúnlẹ̀-kọ.
english_literal: “Pass me not by, dear Redeemer” is not a song one sings on one's knees.
interpretation_gold: The Redeemer helps only those who make an effort in their own behalf.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kí a re odò ká sùn; kí ni ará ilé yó mu?
english_literal: If we go to the river and sleep there, what will the people left at home drink?
interpretation_gold: One must not fail those who depend on one.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kí òyìnbó tó dé la ti ńwọ aṣọ.
english_literal: Long before the white man came we were wearing clothes.
interpretation_gold: One got along pretty well before a certain person came on the scene.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kí ní ḿbẹ nínú isà tí yó ba òkú lẹ́rù?
english_literal: What is there in the grave to frighten a corpse?
interpretation_gold: There is nothing in the offing that one cannot cope with.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kùtù-kùtù kì í jíni lẹ́ẹ̀mejì; kùtù-kùtù ní ńjẹ́ òwúrọ̀; biri ní ńjẹ́ alẹ́.
english_literal: Early dawn does not wake one twice; early dawn is the morning; deep darkness is night.
interpretation_gold: The morning comes only once; whoever wastes it will discover too late that night has fallen.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kò sí oúnjẹ tí ḿmú ara lókun bí èyí tí a jẹ sẹ́nu ẹni lọ.
english_literal: There is no food that nourishes one's body like that one puts in one's own mouth.
interpretation_gold: The only thing one can be sure of is what one has in one's possession.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: “Mo ṣe é tán” ló níyì; a kì í dúpẹ́ aláṣekù.
english_literal: “I have completed the job” is what deserves praise; one does not thank people who leave a job only half done.
interpretation_gold: Whatever one embarks upon, one should see through.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Kí á tó bí ọmọdé, ẹnìkan là ḿbá ṣeré.
english_literal: Before the child was born, one had someone as a playmate.
interpretation_gold: Message to someone that before he/she came around one got along rather well, and one would do so again if the person were to disappear from the scene.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Pà-pà lójú lẹ́ẹ̀kínní, pà-pà lójú lẹ́ẹ̀kejì; bójú náà ò bá fọ́, bàì-bàì ní ńdà.
english_literal: A blow to the eye the first time, and a blow to the eye a second time; if the eye does not go blind it will only see dimly.
interpretation_gold: Continual attacks will eventually leave their mark on the victim.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Pa á ní ńjẹ́ ọgbẹ́, tiiri níńjẹ ọfà; bí a bá ta á ṣe là ńwá a; bí a ò bá wá a a dẹran ìdin.
english_literal: A sharp report is what accompanies a machete wound; a flying motion is the characteristic of an arrow; if one hits a prey one should go in search of it; if not it becomes meat for maggots.
interpretation_gold: Always follow through in your pursuits.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Páńdọ̀rọ̀-ọ́ já, ará rọ ìyá ẹ̀.
english_literal: The fruit of the sausage tree drops, “and” its mother knows relief.
interpretation_gold: Relief is sweet after one's burden has been lifted.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọjọ́ a bá rí ìbí nìbí ńwọlẹ̀.
english_literal: The day one sees the after-birth is the day it enters the earth.
interpretation_gold: Once one perceives a threat one can deal decisively with it.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọbẹ̀ tó dùn, owó ló pa á.
english_literal: A delicious stew was procured with money.
interpretation_gold: Nothing good happens without money.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ṣe kóo ní; àbá ò di tẹni; èèyàn ò ṣoògùn ọrọ̀.
english_literal: Work in order that you might have; intentions do not become possessions; no one makes money by magic.
interpretation_gold: Labor, not idle thought, produces wealth.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀lẹ ò yẹẹ́ ní lọ́mọ.
english_literal: A lazy person is not something one wants as a child.
interpretation_gold: Who wants a lazy child?

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹni tí ó bá pẹ́ lẹ́hìn ni à ńyọ́ omi ọbẹ̀ dè.
english_literal: Those who arrive late are the ones who find the watery residue of the stew awaiting them.
interpretation_gold: Timeliness earns one the best choice, tardiness the worst.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹni tí ó bá wo ojú ìyàwó ní ńmọ̀ pé ìyàwó ńsunkún.
english_literal: Only a person who looks at the bride's face knows that the bride is crying.
interpretation_gold: It is futile to seek sympathy when no one is paying attention.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹni tí kíkí-i rẹ̀ ò yóni, àìkí-i rẹ̀ ò lè pani lébi.
english_literal: A person whose greetings do not fill one's stomach cannot cause one to starve by withholding the greetings.
interpretation_gold: A person whose benevolence has little effect on one's fortune cannot affect one with his/her malevolence.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọwọ́ atẹ́gùn ò ká gẹdú.
english_literal: The wind is no match for timber.
interpretation_gold: Even powerful forces do come up against objects they cannot move.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹ̀rù ogun kì í ba jagun-jagun.
english_literal: Fear of battle never afflicts a warrior.
interpretation_gold: One should be bold in pursuing one's goals.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀lẹ́ wáṣẹ́ rírọ̀ ṣe.
english_literal: The lazy person seeks out an easy task to do.
interpretation_gold: Trust the lazy person to find the easiest tasks.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀ràn búburú kì í bá ikún nílé.
english_literal: An evil event never finds the squirrel at home.
interpretation_gold: A statement that one will never be around when disaster occurs.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹni tí ńgbẹ́lẹ̀ ní ńsìnkú; ẹni tí ńsunkún ariwo ló ńpa.
english_literal: The person digging a grave is the one performing his or her funerary duties; the person crying is merely making a noise.
interpretation_gold: Tangible help is better than useless sympathetic gestures.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọyẹ́ ni yó kìlọ̀ fún onítòbí.
english_literal: It is the harmattan that will teach the person who has only a loin cloth a lesson.
interpretation_gold: People who do not provide for the rainy day will pay when the rain does come.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹgbẹ̀rún ẹja ò lè dẹ́rù pa odò.
english_literal: A thousand fishes will not overload a river.
interpretation_gold: It is futile to attempt to overwhelm an invincible person.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ṣiṣe-é rorò, jíjẹ ọ̀fẹ́.
english_literal: Working is difficult; one would rather freeload.
interpretation_gold: Few people enjoy labor; all would like to live the good life for free.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹni tí ó fò sókè-é bẹ́ ijó lórí.
english_literal: Whoever leaps up decapitates dance.
interpretation_gold: Nothing more can be expected from a person who has given the ultimate effort.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọlọ́mú dá ọmú ìyá ẹ̀ gbé.
english_literal: Each child must lift its mother's breast by itself.
interpretation_gold: Every person to his/her own resources.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹni ọ̀lẹ́ pa-á re ọ̀run òṣì; ẹni iṣẹ́ pa-á re ọ̀run ẹ̀yẹ.
english_literal: Whoever dies from poverty dies a miserable death; whoever dies from work dies a noble death.
interpretation_gold: Better to die on one's feet than to give in to reverses.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀lẹ́ bà á tì, ó kó sílé-e kéú.
english_literal: The lazy person fails at everything, whereupon he goes to a Quaranic school.
interpretation_gold: The lazy person always seeks out the easiest employment.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹṣin kì í já kó já èkejì-i rẹ̀.
english_literal: A horse does not get loose and stop to free its companion.
interpretation_gold: Each person must look to his or her own salvation.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹ̀tẹ́ bá ọ̀lẹ.
english_literal: Disgrace comes upon the shiftless.
interpretation_gold: Disgrace attends shiftlessness.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹni tí ó gbin ọrún èbù tó pè é nígba, tó bá jẹ ọgọ́rùn-ún òtítọ́ tán, á wá jẹ ọgọ́rùn-ún irọ́.
english_literal: The person who plants a hundred yam seedlings and says he planted two hundred, after he has eaten a hundred truths, he will come to eat a hundred lies.
interpretation_gold: A person who overstates his investment will not for all that earn more than the investment can generate.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀nà kì í dí mọ́ aládàá.
english_literal: The path does not close on a man carrying a machete.
interpretation_gold: No problem is insoluble for a resourceful person.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọwọ́ ní ńtún ara ṣe.
english_literal: The hands are the agents for grooming the body.
interpretation_gold: One's well-being is in one's hands.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹlẹ́mùn-ún ò mú eégún.
english_literal: An apprehender does not apprehend a masquerader.
interpretation_gold: Certain people are beyond anyone's control.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọbẹ̀-ẹ́ tutù tán, a dawọ́ bù ú lá.
english_literal: The stew having cooled, one hollows one's palm to eat it.
interpretation_gold: When the back of a difficult task has been broken, people are eager to tackle it.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀mu ní ńgbe ọ̀mu mì.
english_literal: It is drunkenness that swallows (or drowns) a champion drinker.
interpretation_gold: Only an intrepid contestant can match another intrepid contestant.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọmọ tó ṣípá fúnni là ńgbé jó.
english_literal: It is the child that lifts its arms to one that one picks up to dance with.
interpretation_gold: One makes friends with people who offer friendship.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹ̀sọ̀ ẹ̀sọ̀ ni ìgbín fi ńgbà gun igi.
english_literal: Slowly slowly is the way a snail climbs a tree.
interpretation_gold: With dogged persistence, one accomplishes the most difficult of tasks.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọjọ́ tí a dóko là ńjìjà ilẹ̀.
english_literal: The day one gets to the farm is the day one fights over boundaries.
interpretation_gold: Do not procrastinate.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọwọ́ tó dilẹ̀ là ńfi lérán.
english_literal: It is on an idle hand that one rests one's chin.
interpretation_gold: It is when one has nothing to do that one's engages in mischief.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹ̀rù kì í ba orí kó sá wọnú.
english_literal: The head is never so frightened that it disappears into the shoulder.
interpretation_gold: One should be brave enough to meet one's fate.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹni èèyàn ò kí kó yọ̀; ẹni Ọlọ́run ò kí kó ṣọ́ra.
english_literal: Whoever is shunned by people should rejoice; whoever is shunned by God should look out.
interpretation_gold: God's favor is preferable to people's.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹni tí ọ̀ṣọ́ bá wù kó ṣòwò; ẹni ajé yalé-e rẹ̀ ló gbọ́n.
english_literal: Whoever likes fineries should engage in a trade; it is the person blessed by riches that is wise.
interpretation_gold: Good things come only to the industrious.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹ̀rù kì í ba igbó, bẹ́ẹ̀ni kì í ba odò; ẹ̀rù kì í ba ọlọ lójú ata.
english_literal: The forest knows no fear, and neither does the river know fear; the grind-stone never shows fear in the face of pepper.
interpretation_gold: A worthy person should not give way to fear.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọjà tí a fowó rà, owó la fi ńpa.
english_literal: One makes money from goods one purchased with money.
interpretation_gold: One should not make gifts of commodities one purchased for trade.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọjọ́ tí a ńkọ́ṣẹ́ là ńkọ́ ìyára.
english_literal: The day one learns a trade is the day one learns to be quick at it.
interpretation_gold: Whatever one does one should do thoroughly and expertly.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹni tí à ḿbọ́ ò mọ̀ pé ìyàn-án mú.
english_literal: A person fed by others is never aware that there is famine.
interpretation_gold: A person who has no responsibilities does not appreciate the efforts of those who have.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọba tó fi iyùn bọlẹ̀, ọba tó wú u, àwọn méjèèjì la ó máa sọ orúkọ-ọ wọn.
english_literal: The king who buries coral beads, the king who digs them up, both of then will have their names remembered by posterity.
interpretation_gold: Whoever performs an unprecedented feat, whatever it might be, will be remembered by posterity.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀-jẹ-wọ̀mù-wọ̀mù-kú-wọ̀mù-wọ̀mù lorúkọ tí àpà ńjẹ́.
english_literal: One-who-eats-recklessly-and-dies-recklessly is the name one calls a wasteful person.
interpretation_gold: Wasteful people will never learn the value of things.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀lẹ́ kún àárẹ̀ lọ́wọ́.
english_literal: Laziness lends weariness a hand.
interpretation_gold: Laziness is often a contributor to weariness.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹni tí ó forí sọlẹ̀-ẹ́ gbìyànjú ikú.
english_literal: Whoever dives head first to the ground has made a creditable attempt at suicide.
interpretation_gold: One should acknowledge people's sincere efforts.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọlọ́run yó pèsè; kì í ṣe bí èsè oríta.
