english_literal: The Lord will give alms, but not the type one comes upon at crossroads.
interpretation_gold: One wishes for good gifts from God, not just any sort of leavings.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀lẹ́ fi ọ̀ràn gbogbo ṣe “hòo.”
english_literal: The lazy person replies “yes” to all propositions.
interpretation_gold: You will get no argument from a lazy person.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹgbẹ̀rún eèrà ò lè gbé ṣúgà; wọ́n ó kàn tò yí i ká lásán ni.
english_literal: A thousand ants cannot lift “a cube of” sugar; they can only mill around it in vain.
interpretation_gold: Some tasks are beyond certain people.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀ràn fini dùgbẹ̀-dùgbẹ̀ yinni nù; ọ̀ràn fini dùgbẹ̀-dùgbẹ̀ bí ẹnipé kò ní í tán; ọ̀ràn ḿbọ̀ wá tán; ojú á tẹlẹ́gàn, a sì ti ẹni tí ńyọnusọ.
english_literal: A problem shakes one up vigorously and lets one go; a problem shakes one up vigorously as though it would never end; the trouble will end, deflating the ill-wishers and also those who will not mind their own business.
interpretation_gold: However terrible one's problems, they will cease and leave one in better shape than one's enemies would like.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹní máa rí àtisùn-un pẹ́pẹ́yẹ á jẹ gbèsè àdín.
english_literal: Whoever wishes to see ducks go to sleep will go into debt paying for (fuel) oil.
interpretation_gold: Whoever awaits the impossible will wait for ever.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀lẹ èèyàn ò rí ayé wá.
english_literal: A lazy person has found no world to come to.
interpretation_gold: The lot of a lazy person in this world is misery.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀gẹ̀dẹ̀ dúdú ò ṣéé bùṣán; ọmọ burúkú ò ṣéé lù pa.
english_literal: An unripe plantain is not something to eat; a useless child is not something to beat to death.
interpretation_gold: Certain problems one simply has to live with.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹ̀lúlùú ní kàkà kí òun má dun ọbẹ̀, òun á rúnwọ rúnsẹ̀ sí i.
english_literal: The larkheeled Cuckoo vows that rather than not being delicious in the stew, it will crush its arms and legs in pursuit of that end.
interpretation_gold: One vows that even up to the cost of one's life, one will give everything one has to achieve an end.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ṣòkòtò gbọọrọ ò dọlà; abíni lÓÉkòó ò dowó.
english_literal: Long trousers do not amount to wealth; being born in Lagos does not ensure riches.
interpretation_gold: Wealth does not come from dressing well or living in a big city.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀lẹ́ ní ọjọ́ tí òún bá kú òun ó yọ̀; ohun tí ojú ọ̀lẹ́ máa rí kó tó kú ńkọ́?
english_literal: The coward says he will rejoice on the day he dies; but what about the woes he will experience before he dies?
interpretation_gold: Death may offer the coward a respite, but he will suffer before death comes.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹnu òfìfo kì í dún yànmù-yànmù.
english_literal: Empty mouths do not make chewing noises.
interpretation_gold: If one has not filled others' mouths with food, one cannot expect them to be full of one's praise.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ṣòkòtò tí ńṣiṣẹ́ àrán, oko ní ńgbé.
english_literal: The pants that do the work that purchases the velvet fabric stays on the farm.
interpretation_gold: The real workers and producers of wealth are liable to be less in the public eye than their beneficiaries.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹni tí eégún ńlé kó máa rọ́jú; bó ti ńrẹ ará ayé, bẹ́ẹ̀ ní ńrẹ ará ọ̀run.
english_literal: The person being chased by a masquerader should persevere; just as an earthling tires, so does the being from heaven.
interpretation_gold: Perseverance solves all problems.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọjọ́ a bá kọ́ ọ̀lẹ là ńkọ́ inú rírọ́.
english_literal: The day one learns laziness is the day one should learn how to endure a painfully empty stomach.
interpretation_gold: The lazy person should not expect to be fed by others.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀lẹ́ ní ọjọ́ tí ikú bá pa òun, inú òhun á dùn. Ikú ní òun ó jẹ̀ẹ́ kí ojú ẹ̀ rí màbo.
english_literal: The lazy person says on the day he dies, he will be happy. Death says he will visit him (the lazy person) with suffering that is out of this world.
interpretation_gold: There is no way for the lazy person to avoid suffering.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀lẹ́ mọ èèwọ̀ ìjà: ó ní bàbá òún ní kóun má jà lọ́nà oko.
english_literal: The coward knows the preventive for fighting: he says his father has ordered him not to fight on the way to the farm.
interpretation_gold: The coward will use every excuse to get out of a fight.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹjọ́ ẹlẹ́jọ́, lọ́yà ńrò ó, áḿbọ̀ǹtorí ẹjọ́ ara-a rẹ̀.
english_literal: The lawyer argues other people's cases, much more his own.
interpretation_gold: If one is conscientious on behalf of others, one can be expected to be even more conscientious on one's own behalf.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹní bá ńjẹ òbúkọ tó gbójú, yó jẹ àgùtàn tó yọ̀wo.
english_literal: Whoever is used to eating full-grown he-goats will eat lambs that have sprouted horns.
interpretation_gold: A person known for daring deeds can always be expected to defy custom; one cannot cure people of ingrained habits.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọmọ tí yó jẹ̀ẹ́ àṣàmú, kékeré ní ńtií nṣẹnu ṣámú-ṣámú.
english_literal: A person that will become exemplary will begin showing precociousness from childhood.
interpretation_gold: Childhood shows the adult.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹnú dùn-ún ròfọ́; agada ọwọ́ dùn-ún ṣánko.
english_literal: The mouth cooks vegetable stew most expertly; the hand emulating a machete cuts a field most effortlessly.
interpretation_gold: A person's mouth may boast of anything, and his hand may claim to be able to do anything, until he is put to the test.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀lẹ́ jogún ìbáwí.
english_literal: The lazy person inherits recriminations.
interpretation_gold: The lazy person is an tempting scapegoat.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọlọgbọ́n kì í kú sóko ọ̀lẹ; bí ọlọgbọ́n bá kú sóko ọ̀lẹ, ọ̀ràn náà-á nídìí.
english_literal: The wise will not die on a farm for the lazy; if a wise person dies on a farm for the lazy, there must be some explanation.
interpretation_gold: The resourceful person will always find a way out of a predicament.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹni tí ó gbálẹ̀ ni ilẹ̀ ḿmọ́ fún.
english_literal: It is for the person who sweeps the floor that the floor is clean.
interpretation_gold: Those who exert themselves are the ones who reap rewards.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹnu iṣẹ́ ẹni ni a ti ḿmọ ẹni lọ́lẹ.
english_literal: It is at one's occupation that one proves oneself an idler.
interpretation_gold: One reveals one's mettle at one's place of employment.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọba tó sọ ẹgàn di erùfù; ọba tó sọ erùfù dẹgàn, àwọn méjèèjì la ó máa sọ orúkọ-ọ wọn.
english_literal: The king who turned a forest into a sandy plain, the king who turned a sandy plain into a forest, both of their names will be remembered by posterity.
interpretation_gold: Whoever performs a great feat will be remembered by posterity.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọwọ́ ẹni ni yó yòóni.
english_literal: One hands are what feed one to satiation.
interpretation_gold: One's hands are one's best resources.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹsẹ̀ kì í wúwo kí ẹlésẹ̀ má lè gbé e.
english_literal: The feet are never so heavy that the owner cannot lift them.
interpretation_gold: Each person must live with his or her own peculiarities.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹṣin kì í dani kí á má tún gùn ún.
english_literal: One does not refrain from mounting a horse that has thrown one.
interpretation_gold: A failure should not stop one from making further attempts.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọmọ tó káwọ́ sókè ló fẹ́ ká gbé òun.
english_literal: It is the child that lifts up its arms that induces people to lift it.
interpretation_gold: If you want people to come to your aid, first lift a finger on your own behalf.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọwọ́ ẹni la fi ńtú ìwà ara ẹni ṣe.
english_literal: One's own hands are what one uses to mend one's fortune.
interpretation_gold: Each person's fortune is in his/her own hands.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹní máa rí àtisùn akàn á pẹ́ létí isà.
english_literal: Whoever wishes to see a crab go to sleep will stay long by its hole.
interpretation_gold: Whoever seeks the impossible will wait for ever.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀dájú ló bí owó; ìtìjú ló bí gbèsè.
english_literal: It is brazenness that gives birth to wealth; it is excessive reticence that gives birth to poverty.
interpretation_gold: Nothing succeeds without some audaciousness.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹní bá ńṣiṣẹ́ kì í ṣọ̀lẹ; bórí bá túnniṣe a kì í tẹ́ bọ̀rọ̀.
english_literal: Whoever has a job should not malinger; if Providence smiles on one one can hardly fail.
interpretation_gold: Diligence in one's pursuit will certainly result in prosperity.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹni tí iṣẹ́ ńpa-á yá ju ẹni tí ìṣẹ́ ńpa.
english_literal: A person dying from overwork is better than a person dying of destitution.
interpretation_gold: Better to succumb to overwork or occupational hazards than to succumb to poverty.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹni tí ó bá ní ìtara ló ní àtètèbá.
english_literal: It is the industrious person that wins the spoils.
interpretation_gold: Industry ensures success.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọdọọdún làgbẹ̀ ńníyì.
english_literal: It is every year that the farmer receives praise.
interpretation_gold: Statement or prayer that a person will receive perennial praise, just as the annual harvest brings praise to the farmer.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹbọ jíjẹ kì í pa igún.
english_literal: The consumption of sacrificial offerings will not kill the vulture.
interpretation_gold: One's natural calling will not hurt one.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹní máa jẹun kunkun a tìlẹ̀kùn kunkun.
english_literal: Whoever wishes to eat heartily must lock his door firmly.
interpretation_gold: If one wants no intrusion into one's affairs, one should keep them well guarded.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹní gbani láya ò ní kírú ẹni má rà.
english_literal: The person who takes one's wife cannot stop one's locust bean seeds from fermenting.
interpretation_gold: A person who injures one cannot stop one from pursuing one's destiny.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀lẹ́ kákò, ó di òjòjò.
english_literal: The lazy person curls up, and his condition becomes a serious ailment.
interpretation_gold: The simplest tasks become impossible undertakings for the lazy person.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀lẹ́ fẹ́ àrùn kù, ó bú pùrù sẹ́kún.
english_literal: The lazy person cannot find a disease to contract, he bursts into tears.
interpretation_gold: A lazy person will rather catch a disease than submit to work.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọdúnnìí ọdẹ́ pa erin; ẹ̀ẹ̀míràn ọdẹ́ pa ẹfọ̀n; ọdún mẹ́fà ọdẹ́ pa òló; ọlá ńrewájú, tàbí ọlá ńrẹ̀hìn?
english_literal: This year the hunter kills an elephant; the next year the hunter kills a buffalo; two years hence the hunter kills a grass mouse; is his glory increasing or decreasing?
interpretation_gold: One should always strive for greater accomplishments, not lesser.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọjọ́ eré lọ̀ràn ńdun ọ̀lẹ.
english_literal: It is on the day of relaxation that the lazy person experiences regret.
interpretation_gold: People who did not save for a rainy day will regret when those who did save enjoy the benefits of their foresight.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀lẹ́ jogún ìbànújẹ́, ó ní òún jogún ìran òun.
english_literal: The lazy person inherits unhappiness, he says he has inherited the fate of his lineage.
interpretation_gold: The lazy person has himself to blame, not his destiny.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹní máa jẹ oyin inú àpáta kìí wo ẹnu àáké.
english_literal: Whoever will eat the honey in a rock does not worry about the edge of the axe.
interpretation_gold: One should be prepared to bear the sacrifices necessary to achieve a worthy goal.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọ̀lẹ, baba àrùn.
english_literal: Laziness, father of all diseases.
interpretation_gold: Laziness is worse than any disease.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹyẹ ò sọ fún ẹyẹ pé òkò ḿbọ̀.
english_literal: A bird does not tell a bird that a stone is on its way.
interpretation_gold: Each person looks out for his or her own safety.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ẹ̀hìn ológbò kì í balẹ̀.
english_literal: A cat's back never touches the ground.
interpretation_gold: One's opponent in a fight will never succeed in throwing one.

part_theme: perseverance, industry, resilience, self-confidence, self-reliance, resourcefulness, daring
yoruba: Ọmọdé ò mọ ibi tí à ńpọn òun rè.
english_literal: A child does not know where the person who carries it on her back is headed with it.
interpretation_gold: People who depend on others do not know what they have in mind for them.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: A-jí-má-jẹ-ǹkan, a-fàkàṣù-mẹ́fà-ṣoògùn-aràn.
english_literal: He-who-wakes-in-the-morning-and-eats-nothing; he-“who-”makes-a-worm-er-of-six-loaves.
interpretation_gold: The deceitful person deceives himself.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: A kì í rí i ká tún sọ pé a ò ri mọ́.
english_literal: One does not see a thing and then say one does not see it.
interpretation_gold: Always stand by your word.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: A kì í pè é lẹ́rú, ká pè é lóbí.
english_literal: One does not call it a slave and call it a child of the house.
interpretation_gold: One must be clear about one's attitude to a thing or person; ambivalence causes trouble.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: A-gbẹ́jọ́-ẹnìkan-dájọ́, òṣìkà èèyàn.
english_literal: He-who-decides-a-case-after-hearing-only-one-side, (is) the dean of wicked persons.
interpretation_gold: Justice requires considering both sides of a case.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àì-fẹ́-àlejòó-ṣe là ńwí pé “Ọ̀rẹ́ ọ̀rẹ́-ẹ̀ mí dé”; ká ṣáà ti wí pé, “Ọ̀rẹ́-ẹ̀ mí dé.”
english_literal: Reluctance-to-extend-hospitality makes one say, “My friend's friend has arrived”; one should simply say, “My friend has arrived.”
interpretation_gold: If one believes that one's friend's friend is one's friend, then one should not stress that the friend is once removed; one should avoid doubletalk.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: A kì í pè é lẹ́rù ká pè é lọ́ṣọ̀ọ́.
english_literal: One does not call it a burden and also call it an adornment.
interpretation_gold: An event is either a boon or a disaster; never both.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ajá tí ò létí ò ṣéé dẹ̀gbẹ́.
english_literal: A dog without ears is no good for stalking prey.
interpretation_gold: A person who cannot be instructed is useless.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Alápatà ò mọ irú ẹran.
english_literal: The butcher does not know what type the animal is.
interpretation_gold: A butcher is indifferent to the type of animal he butchers.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àgbàká nigbà ńgba ọ̀pẹ.
english_literal: It is completely that the climbing rope encircles the palm-tree.
interpretation_gold: What is worth doing at all is worth doing well; there will be no obstacle in the way of one's ventures.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àdàpè ọ̀rọ̀ ò jẹ́ ká mọ ìtumọ̀ orúkọ.
english_literal: Riddling makes it impossible for one to know the meanings of names.
interpretation_gold: Circuitous talk is liable to lead to confusion.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àjàlá, ta ní nà ọ́? Ìwọ náà kọ́ un?
english_literal: Ajala, who whipped you? It is none other than you, isn't it?
interpretation_gold: An evil does is often also a dissembler.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àgbàká lodi ńgba ìlú.
english_literal: It is completely that a fortification wall encircles a town.
interpretation_gold: Brook no half measures.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Afẹ́nilóbìnrin ò ro ire síni.
english_literal: He-who-has-an-affair-with-one's-wife harbors no good will towards one.
interpretation_gold: One knows one's friends by their behavior.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àjànàkú kúro ni “A rí ǹkan fìrí”; bí a bá rérin ká wí.
english_literal: The elephant is more than something of which one says, “I caught a fleeting glimpse of something”; if one saw an elephant, one should say so.
interpretation_gold: One should not hedge when one discusses the obvious.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: A kì í ṣe ẹlẹ́jọ́ ní “Ngbọ́?”
english_literal: One does not ask the main litigant, “How about it?”
interpretation_gold: Do not expect impartial witnessing from an interested party.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Aṣeburúkú tẹsẹ̀ mọ́nà.
english_literal: The evil doer makes a brisk exit.
interpretation_gold: The evil doer would not wait for his nature to catch up with him.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àpèjúwe lalágbẹ̀dẹ ńrọ̀.
english_literal: The blacksmith manufactures from a description.
interpretation_gold: Unless a person speaks his or her mind, others cannot know what the person has in it.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Adẹ́tẹ̀ẹ́ sọ̀rọ̀ méjì, o fìkan purọ́; ó ní nígbàtí òún lu ọmọ òun lábàrá, òún ja léèékánná pàtì.
english_literal: The leper said two things, one of them being a lie; he said after he had struck his child with his palm, he also pinched him severely with his fingernails.
interpretation_gold: One fools only oneself when one claims to have done the impossible.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àwárí lobìnrin ńwá nǹkan ọbẹ̀.
english_literal: Seeking-until-finding is how a woman seeks ingredients for stew.
interpretation_gold: The dutiful person does not permit difficulties to keep her from accomplishing her duty.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àjò àìwuniíyún là ńdÍfá sí.
english_literal: It is a journey one does not want to make that one consults the oracle about.
interpretation_gold: Where there is no desire, excuses are easy to find.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ajá ní òun ìba má dèé oko rí òun ìbá sọ pé ọ̀run ni wọ́n ti ńkálá wá.
english_literal: The dog says that if it had never been to a farm it would have thought that okra came from heaven.
interpretation_gold: People are apt to hoodwink the innocent or the ignorant.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àfọwọ́rá ní ńjẹ́ olè.
english_literal: Employing-the-hands-to-make-things-disappear is called stealing.
interpretation_gold: Euphemistic circumlocution does not relieve a crime of its true nature.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Afasẹ́gbèjò ńtan ara-a rẹ̀ jẹ.
english_literal: He who would collect rain water in a sieve deceives himself.
interpretation_gold: The shiftless person hurts himself more than others.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: A-kápò-má-ṣọdẹ, ọ̀tá ẹranko, ọ̀tá èèyàn.
english_literal: He-who-carries-a-hunting-bag-but-does-not-hunt, enemy alike of man and beast.
interpretation_gold: Be not a dog in the manger.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Afìkọ̀kọ̀jalè, bí ọba ayé ò rí ọ, tọ̀rún rí ọ.
english_literal: You-who-steal-in-secret, if an earthly king does not see you, the heavenly king sees you.
interpretation_gold: Nothing is hidden from God.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: A kì í sọ̀rọ̀ ìkọ̀kọ̀ kó má diyàn ní gba-n-gba.
english_literal: One does not conspire in secret without the matter eventually causing a public argument.
interpretation_gold: Whatever is done in secret soon becomes exposed.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Apani kì í jẹ́ ká mú idà kọjá nípàkọ́ òun.
english_literal: A murderer never permits the passage of a sword behind his skull.
interpretation_gold: The criminal is ever suspicious of other people's intentions.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Arítẹnimọ̀ọ́wí, ó fi àpáàdì ràbàtà bo tirẹ̀ mọ́lẹ̀.
english_literal: He-who-eagerly-speaks-of-one's-problems, he covers his own with a huge potsherd.
interpretation_gold: People will talk about others' problems, while carefully hiding theirs.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Afatarẹ́nilójú, alè-e baále.
english_literal: One-who-smears-one's-eyes-with-pepper, one's husband's concubine.
interpretation_gold: The illicit lover of a woman's husband is no friend of hers.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ajá ti erée rẹ̀ẹ́ bá dánilójú là ńdẹ sí ehoro.
english_literal: It is a dog in whose speed one has faith that one sics at a hare.
interpretation_gold: One entrusts important tasks only to those one can trust.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Apajájẹ-ẹ́ ní ẹ̀rù adìẹ ḿba òun.
english_literal: The-person-who-kills-and-eats-dogs claims to be afraid of chickens.
interpretation_gold: A hardened criminal pretends to have scruples about mere peccadillos.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àgbàdo kì í ṣe èèyàn; ta ní ńrí ọmọ lẹ́hìn eèsún.
english_literal: The maize plant is not human; who ever saw children on the back of elephant grass?
interpretation_gold: One should not overestimate the value of things.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Agada ò morí alágbẹ̀dẹ.
english_literal: The sword cannot tell the smith's head from others.
interpretation_gold: Natural justice does not play favorites.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àbẹ̀tẹ́lẹ̀ ní ńfọ́jú onídàájọ́.
english_literal: It is bribery that blinds a judge.
interpretation_gold: Bribery beclouds judgement.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àkàsọ̀ faratilẹ̀ faratilé; bí ẹni tí a fẹ̀hìntì óò bá yẹni a wí fúnni.
english_literal: A ladder rests on the ground and leans on the house; if the person one leans on must remove his support he should warn one.
interpretation_gold: A person one trusts should be completely trustworthy.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: A-ṣọ̀tún-ṣòsì-má-ba-ibìkan-jẹ́; irọ́ la ó bàá níbẹ̀.
english_literal: One-who-is-tight-with-the-right-and-tight-with-left-without-alienating-either; what one will find in that characterization is a lie.
interpretation_gold: There is no way to be tight with both sides of a quarrel without betraying one side.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àsọ̀rọ̀àìlàdí ló pa Elempe ìṣáájú tó ní igbá wúwo ju àwo.
english_literal: Speaking-without-explaining killed the first Elempe who said that calabash was heavier than china.
interpretation_gold: Excessive economy in speech leads to obscurity.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àbàtá pani; àbàtá pani; ká ṣá sọ pé odò-ó gbéni lọ.
english_literal: He died in the mire; he died in the mire; let us simply say that the person drowned.
interpretation_gold: One should prefer plain talk to euphemisms.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Asárélówó ḿbẹ lọ́nà ogun; Apọ̀ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ḿbẹ lọ́nà èrò; Bó-pẹ́-títí-ng-ó-là ḿbẹ lábà, ó ńjẹ ẹ̀sun iṣu.
english_literal: He-who-hurries-after-riches is on his way to battle; He-who-has-in-abundance is off on his travels; By-and-by-“I-will-be-rich” is back in his hut, eating roasted yams.
interpretation_gold: Wealth comes to those who exert themselves, not to those who wait for it to find them.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Afọ́jú àjànàkú, kò mọ igi, kò mọ èèyàn.
english_literal: A blind elephant does not know a man from a tree.
interpretation_gold: Fate is no respecter of persons.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Alákatam̀pò ò mọ irú ẹran.
english_literal: The user of a cross-bow does not know what type of game he shoots at.
interpretation_gold: Some people lack a sense of discrimination.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àwíyé ní ḿmú ọ̀ràn yéni; ọ̀ọ́dúnrún okùn la fi ńsin ẹgbẹ̀ta; bí a ò bá là á, kì í yeni.
english_literal: Explicitness makes matters clear; it takes three-hundred strings to string six hundred; unless one explains it, no one understands.
interpretation_gold: Too much economy in speech leads to confusion.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Adánu tí ńjẹ ilá: ó ní “Ẹ ò rí ilẹ̀ báyìí?”
english_literal: Cleft-lipped person eating okro; he complains, “Can you believe what a mess the floor is?”
interpretation_gold: The culprit complains about a condition as though he or she had nothing to do with it.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Àdàpè olè ní ńjẹ́ “ọmọ-ọ̀ mi ńfẹ́wọ́.”
english_literal: It is a euphemistic description of stealing to say, “My child's hands are uncontrollably nimble.”
interpretation_gold: One should face facts and not skirt them.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: A kì í rí ẹṣin ní ìso.
english_literal: One does not find a horse on tether.
interpretation_gold: Too easy and too convenient a find suggests stealing.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: A kì í ró aṣọ ajé sídìí ká dájọ́ òdodo lẹ́bi.
english_literal: One does not wear the ritual loincloth for presiding over a trial-by-ordeal and judge the righteous guilty.
interpretation_gold: One must not violate the oath one is sworn to observe.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Arúgbó oǹdágbèsè, ó ní mélòó ni òun ó dùúró san níbẹ̀?
english_literal: The old person who incurs debt, he says how much of it will he be around to repay?
interpretation_gold: A person whose days are numbered can afford to freely take on long-term obligations.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: A kì í so ẹran mẹ́ran kó kàn án pa.
english_literal: One does not tie a goat with another goat and keep one from butting the other to death.
interpretation_gold: One must not injure a person committed to one's protection.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí abẹ́rẹ́ bí abẹ́rẹ́ lèèyàn ńṣèké; ọjọ́ tó bá tóbi tó ọkọ́ tí a fi ńroko ní ńpani.
english_literal: Like a needle, like a needle, one compiles falsehood; the day it is as big as the hoe one uses on a farm, that is the day it kills one.
interpretation_gold: Small falsehoods eventually grow into a habit powerful enough to kill.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí obìnrín bá máa dán èké wò, a da aṣọ dúdú bora.
english_literal: When a woman wishes to engage in mischief, she wears dark clothing.
interpretation_gold: A woman's furtiveness portends mischief.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí o rí i, wà pé o ò rí; ọkọ́ fún ọ lówó, àlé gbà á ná.
english_literal: If you saw it you would say you did not; your husband gave you money and your lover spends it.
interpretation_gold: An unfaithful woman deserves no trust.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí o ní ọ̀pọ̀ oògùn, tí o ní èké, kò níí jẹ́; orí ẹní jẹ́ ó ju ewé lọ; ìpín jà ó ju oògùn lọ.
english_literal: If you have a great deal of medicine and you are false, it will not work; one's head works better than any herb; one's destiny is far more effective than any medicine.
interpretation_gold: One's evil intentions make one's medicine ineffective; one's best hope lies in one's head and one's destiny.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí a bá ńyọ́lẹ̀ dà, ohun abẹ́nú a máa yọ́ni ṣe.
english_literal: If one engages secretly in treachery, secret disasters befall one.
interpretation_gold: Crimes committed in secret do not go unrequited.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí ó ti wù kó pẹ́ tó, olóòótọ́ ò níí sùn sípò ìkà.
english_literal: However long it takes, a truthful person will not wind up in the bed made for the wicked.
interpretation_gold: Whatever happens in the short run, in the long run the truthful person will be vindicated.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí olókùnrùn yó bàá kú, kó má purọ́ mọ́ àlapà; omitooro kì í korò.
english_literal: If an invalid is approaching death, he should not lie about the melon-seed loaf; stew is never bitter.
interpretation_gold: If one must make excuses for one's flaws, one should make them plausible.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí ojú bá sé ojú; kí ohùn má yẹ ohùn.
english_literal: If eyes no longer see eyes, let the voice not miss the voice.
interpretation_gold: Though separated by distances, people should keep agreements they made.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí ẹnú bá jẹ, ojú á tì.
english_literal: If the mouth has eaten, the eyes shut down.
interpretation_gold: If one has received some favor from a person, one's eyes will be closed to the person's faults.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí ọgbọ́n bá tán nínú, a tún òmíràn dá.
english_literal: When an elder has exhausted all his wisdom, he turns to another wisdom.
interpretation_gold: An elder is never at a loss for what to do.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí ìgbín ńfà, ìkaraun a tẹ̀lé é.
english_literal: When the snail crawls, its shell follows.
interpretation_gold: The dependent person always sticks close to his or her support.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí ọmọdé bá ri oyin, a ju àkàrà nù.
english_literal: When a child sees honey, he throws away bean fritters.
interpretation_gold: The inconstant person's concern is limited to the latest attraction.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí ọmọdé bá mọ igbá-di-ogóje, kò lè mọ èrò-kò-wájà.
english_literal: If a youth knows two-hundred-becomes-one-hundred-and-forty, he cannot know traders-refuse-to-come-to-the-market.
interpretation_gold: A person who knows how to cheat those who deal with him will not know how to win them back when they refuse to deal with him.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí o finú ṣìkà tí o fòde ṣòótọ́, ọba séríkí á rín ọ rín ọ.
english_literal: If you hide wickedness inside you and display a kindly disposition, God above will laugh hard at you.
interpretation_gold: No secret act of wickedness is concealed from God.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí òru bí òru ní ńṣe aláṣọdúdú.
english_literal: Longing for night-time, longing for night-time is the tendency of the person in dark clothing.
interpretation_gold: A person engaged in secret business is always secretive.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Bí ìkà-á bá ńrojọ́, ìkà kọ́ ni yó dàá a.
english_literal: If the wicked person states a case, it is not the wicked person that will judge it.
interpretation_gold: The wicked will not prevail in the face of impartial judges.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Dúkìa tí a fi èrú kójọ kò mú ká dolówó.
english_literal: The treasure one gathers by foul means will not make one rich.
interpretation_gold: Wealth garnered by foul means does not last.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Èrò ò kí baálẹ̀, baálé ló ńkí.
english_literal: The guest does not pay homage to the chief, only to the host.
interpretation_gold: One's first obligation is to one's immediate benefactor, not to the remote authority, however great.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: “Ebí ńpa mí” ò ṣéé fìfé wí.
english_literal: “I am hungry” is not a message that whistling can convey.
interpretation_gold: A person in need of help must not be coy or cryptic in asking.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Elékèé lèké ńyè; oun a bá ṣe ní ńyéni.
english_literal: Only a devious person knows what he or she is about; each person alone is privy to what he or she has done.
interpretation_gold: One can never be sure about a devious person.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Èlùbọ́ lo wáá rà; ọmọ ẹrán ṣe dénú igbá?
english_literal: You came to buy yam-flour; how did a kid find its way into your calabash?
interpretation_gold: The alibi offered by a culprit (subject of the proverb) is full of holes.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Èké mọ ilé-e rẹ̀ ó wó; ọ̀dàlẹ́ mọ tirẹ̀ ó bì dànù.
english_literal: The devious person builds a house and it collapses; the treacherous person builds one and it tumbles in ruins.
interpretation_gold: Evil people will not profit from their enterprises.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Etí tó gbọ́ àlọ ni yó gbọ̀ọ́ àbọ̀.
english_literal: The same ears that heard about the departure will hear about the return.
interpretation_gold: Whoever is privy to the genesis of an affair will (must) be privy to its conclusion.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Eléwe-é ní iyènú; àìní mọ ìwà-á hù.
english_literal: A person who has children must be responsible; one who does not must know how to behave.
interpretation_gold: One should live up to one's responsibilities.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Èké lojú ó tì bó dọ̀la.
english_literal: The devious will reap shame in the future.
interpretation_gold: Wickedness with receive its just deserts in due time.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Eegun tí a bá so mọ́ ajá lọ́rùn, kì í ṣán an.
english_literal: A dog does not eat a bone tied to its neck.
interpretation_gold: One may not take advantage of a person or thing entrusted to one's care.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ewúrẹ́ ní òun ò mọlé odì; ẹni òún bá ṣẹ̀ kó bi òun.
english_literal: The goat says it does not set aside any house as an enemy's; whoever it has offended should ask it why.
interpretation_gold: One wants no enemies; if one has offended anyone, the person should ask why.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Etí, gbọ́ èkejì kí o tó dájọ́.
english_literal: Ear, hear the other side before passing judgement.
interpretation_gold: One should not form an opinion after hearing only one side of an argument.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Fi inú ṣìkà, fi òde ṣòótọ́; ẹni tí ḿbini kò níí ṣàì bini.
english_literal: Hide wickedness in you and affect a benevolent comportment; the one who calls people to account will not forget.
interpretation_gold: God sees all hidden acts of wickedness and metes out punishment to their perpetrators.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Gba-n-gba làṣá ńta.
english_literal: The hawk always spreads its wings to the fullest.
interpretation_gold: Whatever one has in mind, one should lay it out fully in the open.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Gba-n-gba là ńṣe gbàǹgbà; bẹ́ṣín bá kú, ìta gbangba là ńsin í sí.
english_literal: One performs one's great feats in the open; if a horse dies, one buries it in a wide open space.
interpretation_gold: One should not attempt to keep weighty matters under wraps.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Gbogbo wa la fòkété san ọgọ́fà; ìgbà tí òkété ó fi di ogóje, ojú-u gbogbo wa ni yó ṣe.
english_literal: We all agreed on a hundred and twenty cowries as the value of the bush rat; when the value changes to a hundred and forty, we must all know about it.
interpretation_gold: No sub-group has the right to alter in secret decisions the whole group has arrived at.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Irọ́ ni “Má jẹ̀ẹ́nìkan ó gbọ́”; òótọ́ ni “Ẹni o rí o bi.”
english_literal: “Breathe not a word of it to anyone” denotes a lie; “Ask anyone you please” indicates the truth.
interpretation_gold: It is a only a lie that one wants no witness to; one will gladly proclaim the truth.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Igbó kannáà lọdẹ ńdẹ.
english_literal: It is in the same forest that a hunter hunts (or all hunters hunt).
interpretation_gold: One should stick to that which one knows. Or, the manners and behaviors of members of a fraternity should be consistent and uniform.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ìmàlé gbààwẹ̀ ó lóun ò gbétọ́ mì; ta ní ńṣe ẹlẹ́rìí fún un?
english_literal: The muslim fasts and swears he did not swallow his saliva; who is to corroborate his story?
interpretation_gold: There is no point is paying attention to a claim that cannot be verified.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ìmùlẹ̀ ò gbọdọ̀ tan ara wọn jẹ; ìmọ̀ ẹnìkan ò yàn.
english_literal: Those who enter into a covenant must not betray one another; one person's counsel is not enough by itself.
interpretation_gold: One must not break covenants.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ìlú tí a bá rè là ḿbá pé.
english_literal: The citizenry one goes abroad with is the one in whose ranks one remains.
interpretation_gold: One should not desert one's colleagues midway through an enterprise.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ìpẹ́pẹ́rẹ́ ìgò méje; bí kò bá pé méje ara kì í gbà á.
english_literal: Seven thrifling bottles; fewer than seven and one cannot endure the thought.
interpretation_gold: If a matter is really of no importance, one should not nevertheless dwell on it.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ibi tí a ti na ọmọ ọba là ḿbèrè, a kì í bèrè ibi tí ọmọ ọbá ti pọ́n lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́.
english_literal: What one should ask is where the prince was attacked and flogged; one does not ask where the prince got the welts on his side.
interpretation_gold: When matters require urgent attention, one should not speak in riddles or prevaricate.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ilé ahun ò gba ahun; ọ̀dẹ̀dẹ̀ ahun ò gbàlejò; ahún kọ́lé ẹ̀ tán ó yọ ọ̀dẹ̀dẹ̀ níbàdí.
english_literal: The tortoise's house is not large enough for it; the tortoise's porch is not large enough to receive visitors; the tortoise built its house and adds a porch at the rear.
interpretation_gold: The miser never has enough to share with others.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ìmàlé sọ̀rọ̀ òjò-ó kù, ó ní Ọlọ́runún jẹ́rì-í òun.
english_literal: The muslim says something and thunder rumbles; he says the Almighty is corroborating his statement.
interpretation_gold: Said of someone who claims a neutral evidence as support for his/her position.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ìkòkò kì í ṣelé ìgbín; ṣe ló dè ìgbín mọ́lẹ̀.
english_literal: The pot is no shelter for the snail; all it does is trap the snail.
interpretation_gold: One should not try to pass off injury one is causing a person as some favor one is doing the person.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ìjòkó là ḿbá eèbà.
english_literal: The oil pot is ever found in a sitting position.
interpretation_gold: The constancy of the pot is worth emulating.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: “Jẹ́ kí nfìdí hẹ́ ẹ”-ẹ́ gbàjòkó; àfòmọ́ di onílé.
english_literal: “Permit me to perch by you” takes the whole seat; the parasite becomes the host.
interpretation_gold: Said of people who take over by wiles what belongs to others.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Kí á rí ká rà, ká rà ká má san; à-rà-àì-san èkejìolè.
english_literal: To see and buy, to buy and not pay; buying without paying “is” the twin of stealing.
interpretation_gold: One should pay for whatever one buys.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Kò jọ agbe kò jọ olè tí ńsúfèé yàgbàdo; bí kò bá bá mi a di olè; bó bá bá mi a di onílé.
english_literal: It-is-not-begging-and-it-is-not-stealing who whistles as he harvests corn ears; if he does not come upon me it becomes stealing; if he comes upon me it becomes “the action of” a member of the household.
interpretation_gold: Said of a person who secretively takes something from his/her relative instead of asking openly for it.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Kí á gà, kí á gò, èdè ni ò yédè.
english_literal: Sitting and refusing to budge from one's position results from lack of communication.
interpretation_gold: It is when people fail to compromise that problems defy solution.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Kí olówó wá, kí aláwìn wá; à-rà-àì-san ni ò sunwọ̀n.
english_literal: Let the purchaser with cash come and let the purchaser on credit come; only buying without “eventually” paying is bad.
interpretation_gold: What is important is that one fulfil one's obligation, not so much when.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Kò sí ohun tí a ò lè fi òru ṣe; ẹ̀rù ọ̀sán là ḿbà.
english_literal: There is nothing one cannot do in the dead of night; the light of day alone is what one fears.
interpretation_gold: The cover of darkness is a perfect protection for any sort of enterprise.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: “Kò dùn mí, kò dùn mí”; àgbàlagbà ḿbú ọpa lẹ́ẹ̀mẹfà nítorí iyán àná.
english_literal: “I am not upset, I am not upset!” Yet a grown man swears angrily six times because of last night's pounded yam.
interpretation_gold: A person's protestation of indifference is belied by his/her agitated behavior.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Kí a baà lè pẹ́ níbẹ̀, abuké ní bí òún bá kú, kí wọ́n ti ẹ̀hìn tú ìfun òun.
english_literal: Just to delay people deliberately, the humpback says when he dies his intestines should be removed from the back.
interpretation_gold: Said of people resorting to transparent delaying tactics.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: “Mo kò ó” kì í ṣe àìní àpèjúwe.
english_literal: “I met him” is an incomplete statement without further elaboration.
interpretation_gold: One should say enough to make one's message understood.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Má sẹ̀ẹ́ kí ọ̀ràn má pọ̀.
english_literal: Do not deny your responsibility; that way the problem will be minimized.
interpretation_gold: Refusing to accept one's responsibility only aggravates one's difficulties.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Nígbàtí ọwọ́ ò tẹ ìjàdù là ńní kò sí ohun tí à ńjẹ tí kì í tán.
english_literal: It is when one has come up empty in a scramble for food that one says there is nothing one eats that is not finished sooner or later.
interpretation_gold: An affectation of indifference is often disguised disappointment.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Nì palaba, ní wonko, ẹ̀rẹ̀kẹ́ á ṣèkan.
english_literal: Either sunken or swollen, the cheeks will be one or the other.
interpretation_gold: If one is not one way one must be the other way; one cannot be no way at all.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Òtítọ́ dọ́jà ó kùtà; owó lọ́wọ́ là ńra èké.
english_literal: Truth arrives at the market but finds no buyer; it is with ready cash, though, that people buy falsehood.
interpretation_gold: People appreciate falsehood more than truthfulness.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Òtítọ́ ní ńtú ẹrù ìkà palẹ̀.
english_literal: It is truth that unpacks the load of the wicked for all to see.
interpretation_gold: Truth will triumph over the wicked.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Obìnrin-ín re ilé àlè, ó fi ilé ìyá ẹ̀ tan ọkọ jẹ.
english_literal: A woman goes to her lover's house and uses her mother's home to deceive her husband.
interpretation_gold: Legitimate pursuits often serve as cover for illegitimate ones.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: O kò pọ̀ ọ́, bẹ́ẹ̀ni o ò gbé e mì.
english_literal: You do not spit it out, and yet you do not swallow it.
interpretation_gold: Said of a person who will not accept or reject a proposition.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Òjò ọ̀gànjọ́ ò pa ẹni rere; bí kò pa jalè-jalè a pa yíde-yíde.
english_literal: A midnight rain does not beat a decent person; if the person it beats is not a habitual thief he/she will be a habitual “night” wanderer.
interpretation_gold: Honest people are seldom caught in compromising positions.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Òkété ní ọjọ́ gbogbo lòún mọ̀, òun ò mọ ọjọ́ mìíràn.
english_literal: The large bush rat says it knows everyday, but not some other day.
interpretation_gold: If one makes a promise, it should be firm and definite, not vague.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Òtítọ́ kì í ṣìnà; irọ́ ní ńforí gbọgbẹ́.
english_literal: Truth never goes awry; it is falsehood that earns a gash on the head.
interpretation_gold: Truth will not bring misfortune; falsehood leads to trouble in the end.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: “Orí jẹ́ kí mpé méjì” obìnrin ò dénú.
english_literal: “May my head grant that I have a partner” as a woman's prayer is not sincere.
interpretation_gold: People often pay lip service to concepts they do not believe in.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Òkóbó kì í bímọ sítòsí.
english_literal: The eunuch never has children close by.
interpretation_gold: The person who has something to hide will always offer outlandish explanations.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ojo díẹ̀, akin díẹ̀; ìyà ní ńkó jẹni.
english_literal: A little cowardice, a little bravery; all it brings one is trouble.
interpretation_gold: One should decide whether one will be bold or cowardly; inconsistency in such matters results in suffering.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Obìnrin-ín pẹ́ lọ́jà ó fìgbójú wọlé.
english_literal: A woman tarried too long at the market and returns home with a brazen face.
interpretation_gold: An offender will try to ward off criticism by first going on the offensive.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ojú lobìnrin-ín mọ̀.
english_literal: Women know only the face.
interpretation_gold: The only time one can rely on women is when one is present.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ohun tí a ò fẹ́ kéèyàn ó mọ̀ là ńṣe lábẹ́lẹ̀.
english_literal: It is what one wishes to keep a secret that one does in private.
interpretation_gold: If one has nothing to hide, one should not do things in secret.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Òtítọ́ korò; bí omi tooro nirọ́ rí.
english_literal: Truth is bitter; falsehood is like meat stew.
interpretation_gold: It is more difficult to be truthful than to lie.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Odídẹrẹ́ ẹyẹ òkun, àlùkò ẹyẹ ọ̀sà; bí a bá jẹun gbé, ká má jẹ̀ẹ́ùn gbé.
english_literal: The parrot is a bird of the sea, and the kingfisher a bird of the lagoon; even though we might forget that we once partook in the food, let us never forget what we covenanted.
interpretation_gold: However far we may roam, and however long, one should never forget promises made.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Owó lobìnrin-ín mọ̀.
english_literal: Women care only about money.
interpretation_gold: Whatever women do they do only for money.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ó ta ọfà sókè, ó ṣí odó borí.
english_literal: He shot an arrow towards the sky and covers his head with a mortar.
interpretation_gold: Said of a person who causes problems and goes into hiding, leaving others to suffer the consequences.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Òfìífìí là ńrí, a ò rí òkodoro; òkodoro ḿbọ̀, baba gba-n-gba.
english_literal: All we see is shadows, not clarity; but clarity will come, father of all openness.
interpretation_gold: The truth may be hidden for long, but in the end it will emerge into the open.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ó jọ gàtè, kò jọ gàtè, ó fẹsẹ̀ méjèèjì tiro rìn.
english_literal: It may seem like staggering, and it may not seem like staggering, but he is tipping forward on tiptoes.
interpretation_gold: A euphemism does not make an action anything other than what it is.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ó pẹ́ títí ni “A-bẹnu-bí-ẹnu-ọ̀bọ”; ká ṣá sọ pé, “Ìwọ Lámọnrín, ọ̀bọ ni ọ́.”
english_literal: It is mere circumlocution to say “A person has a mouth like a monkey's”; one should rather say, “You, so-and-so, you are a monkey.”
interpretation_gold: One should be confident enough to speak without hedging.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ojú olóbì la ti ńjèrè obì.
english_literal: It is in the presence and with the knowledge of the kola-nut seller that one receives a gratuitous addition to one's purchase.
interpretation_gold: If one has a right to something, one should not take it surreptitiously.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Òtítọ́ lolórí ìwà.
english_literal: Truthfulness is the chief of attributes.
interpretation_gold: There is no better attribute than truthfulness.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Òǹrorò lẹ̀gbọ́n òfófó.
english_literal: Lack of compassion is the elder of back-biting.
interpretation_gold: A person who lacks compassion will think nothing of spreading false news about others.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Òtítọ́ kì í kú ká fi irọ́ jọba.
english_literal: The truth does not die to be replaced as king by the lie.
interpretation_gold: The lie cannot match the truth in esteem.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Obìnrin-ín bímọ fúnni kò pé kó má pani; obìnrin ò bímọ fúnni kò pé kó má pani.
english_literal: That a woman has had one's child does not mean she cannot kill one; that a woman has not had one's child does not mean she may not kill one.
interpretation_gold: Intimacy is no protection against a woman.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ògèdèm̀gbé irọ́ kì í dáni síyẹ̀wù; gba-n-gba ní ńdáni sí.
english_literal: An audacious lie does not trip one in one's closet; it exposes one in a public place.
interpretation_gold: One's transgressions are liable to catch up with one in the most embarrassing circumstances.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ojú kì í fẹ́nikù kó hu ibi.
english_literal: The eyes do not, because they do not see one, engage in evil against one.
interpretation_gold: Never take advantage of people's absence to do them ill.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Obì-í bọ́ lọ́wọ́ alákẹdun ó ní òún fún ará ilẹ̀; bí kò fún ará ilẹ̀, yó sọ̀kalẹ̀ wá mú u?
english_literal: Kolanut dropped from the grips of a monkey and it says it makes a gift of that to ground dwellers; if he does not make a gift of it to ground dwellers would it come down to fetch it?
interpretation_gold: One can tell when necessity is being disguised as virtue.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Olóòótọ́ kì í sùn sípò ìkà.
english_literal: The honest person will not sleep in the place prepared for the wicked person.
interpretation_gold: The honest person will in the end be vindicated.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ojú tó ti mọni rí kì í wípe òun ò mọni mọ́.
english_literal: The eyes that used to recognize one cannot say they no longer recognize one.
interpretation_gold: Whatever happens, one should not refuse to acknowledge one's friends.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Olóòótọ́ ìlú nìkà ìlú.
english_literal: The honest person in a town is the ogre of the town.
interpretation_gold: Honesty seldom makes one popular.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: “Ó mọ́ mi lọ́wọ́” ní ńdi olè.
english_literal: “It is an exact fit for my hand” leads to thievery.
interpretation_gold: One should not grow too attached to other people's possessions.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: “Ó fò sókè ó pẹ́ títí,” irọ́ ló ńpa.
english_literal: “He jumped up and stayed aloft almost for ever”: that is a lie.
interpretation_gold: One should control the urge to exaggerate.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ojú lọ̀rọ̀-ọ́ wà.
english_literal: Discourse is in the eyes.
interpretation_gold: One should look the person with whom one is holding a dialogue in the eyes.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ojú gba-n-gba là ńta awọ gbà-ǹ-gbà.
english_literal: It is out in the open that one spreads a huge skin.
interpretation_gold: A matter that is of great consequence to all should be discussed in the presence of all.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Obìnrin abàlèmẹ́fà: àlè mẹ́fà ò mọ ara wọn.
english_literal: A woman who has six lovers: the six lovers never know about one another.
interpretation_gold: Women are past mistresses of deceit.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ó ńṣe apá kúlú-kúlú bí ẹni ká gbé e jó, ó sì ńṣẹnu hàmù-hàmù bí èyí tí yó gbèéni mì.
english_literal: It wiggles its arms as though it would have one dance with it, and yet it is working its mouth as though it would swallow one.
interpretation_gold: Said of a person who mixes friendly gestures with threatening ones.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Olòfòófó ò gbẹ́gbàá; ibi ọpẹ́ ní ḿmọ.
english_literal: The tattler does not earn six pence; thanks are all he gets.
interpretation_gold: Tattling is not a profitable or appreciated habit.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Pẹ̀hìndà kí o ríṣe èké, fara pamọ́ kí o rí bí aṣení ti ńsọ.
english_literal: Turn your back you and you will discover how the deceitful person behaves; hide and you will find out what the detractor is saying.
interpretation_gold: Were one able to surprise them, one would discover the true nature of one's enemies.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Pátá-pátá leégún ńfaṣọ borí;.
english_literal: It is completely that the masquerader covers his head with his shroud.
interpretation_gold: One must be thoroughgoing in whatever one does.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Purọ kóo níyì; bí a bá jáni tán, ẹ̀tẹ́ ní ńdà.
english_literal: Lie and become renowned; once you have been found out the result is disgrace.
interpretation_gold: The glory that results from deceit does not last.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Pàkìtí ṣe bí òkú wọ̀lú; labalábá ṣe bí ẹyẹ jáko.
english_literal: The coarse mat enters the town like a corpse; the butterfly enters the bush like a bird.
interpretation_gold: Said of people who appear to be what they are not.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Pípọn niyì idẹ; ẹ̀jẹ́ niyì oògun.
english_literal: Redness is the glory of brass; efficaciousness is the glory of medicine.
interpretation_gold: Truth to one's nature, and fulfilment of one's obligations are the determinants of one's worth.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Pọ̀ǹgbà-pọngba là ḿbá odi.
english_literal: Firmly planted and unshakable is the way one finds the city fortification.
interpretation_gold: An injunction to be firm and unshakable.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Pátá-pátá; là ńfọ́jú, kùm̀bọ̀-kumbọ là ńdẹ́tẹ̀; ojú à-fọ́-ì-fọ́-tán ìjà ní ńdá sílẹ̀.
english_literal: One's blindness should be absolute, and one's leprosy should pervade the whole body; half-blindness only brings dissensions.
interpretation_gold: One's condition should be definite, not ambiguous or undetermined.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Rìkíṣí pa wọ́n pọ̀ wọ́n dọ̀rẹ́; kò lọ́jọ́ kò lóṣù ọ̀rẹ́ bàjẹ́.
english_literal: Intrigue brought them together and they became friends; it did not take days, let alone months, before the friendship ended.
interpretation_gold: People united in friendship by intrigue soon become enemies.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Rìkíṣí pin, alábòsí lọ.
english_literal: When the intrigue is terminated, and the devious person takes his leave.
interpretation_gold: When the intrigue is exposed, the career of the devious person is over.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Sàráà baba ẹbọ.
english_literal: Alms are the ultimate sacrifice.
interpretation_gold: It is blessed to give alms.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ta ló dè ọ́ tí ò ńkakọ?
english_literal: Who has tied you down and thus forced you to confess your guilt?
interpretation_gold: Said to stop the mouths of people who protest too much as a result of a guilty conscience.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ta leṣinṣin ìbá gbè bí kò ṣe elégbò?
english_literal: Who else will the flies flock after if not the person with open sores.
interpretation_gold: Opportunistic people can be expected to stick with those who offer them the most benefits.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ta la domi sí lára? Ta lòrìṣà ńgùn?
english_literal: Who is the one on whom water was poured? Who is the one being mounted by the god?
interpretation_gold: The person receiving all the attention cannot pretend that he is not the one in need of attention.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ta là bá rí báwí bí ẹní fọmọ fọ́kọ lóru, tí ò jẹ́ kílẹ̀ mọ́?
english_literal: Whom should one blame, if not the person who delivered a child to a husband in the middle of the night without waiting until daylight.
interpretation_gold: The person to blame in the event of a preventable problem is the one whose thoughtless action causes it.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Wọ́n ní kárúgbó gba ọmọ pọ̀n, ó ní ṣe bí wọ́n mọ̀ pé òun ò léhín; wọ́n ní kó pa ọmọ jẹ ni?
english_literal: The old woman is asked to carry a child on her back, and she says but they know she has no teeth; was she asked to eat the child.
interpretation_gold: Said of people whose comment on a proposition is wildly irrelevant.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: “Wá jẹun.” “Ng ò jẹ.” Ó fọgọ́rùnún òkèlè tọ́ ọbẹ̀ wò.
english_literal: “Come join me at my meal.” “Thank you, but no.” Still he eats a hundred mouthfuls, just to taste the stew.
interpretation_gold: If you intend to decline an invitation, match your action to your words.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Wọ́n ní,; “Àwòko, o bú ọba.” Ó ní ìgbà wo lòún ráàye bú ọba, kóun tó kọ igba lówùúrọ̀, igba lọ́sàn-án, igba lálẹ́, kóun tó fi àyìndà-yindà lù ú?
english_literal: They said, “Mocking bird, you are accused of insulting the king.” It asked when would it have time to insult the king, seeing that it must sing two hundred songs in the morning, two hundred in the afternoon, and two hundred at night, mixing it all up with some frolicsome notes?
interpretation_gold: The person in trouble will resort to ludicrous alibis to escape punishment.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹní gbé àrùn pamọ́ kọjá ore oníṣègùn.
english_literal: Whoever conceals a disease is beyond help from a doctor.
interpretation_gold: People in need of help should not conceal the fact.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹni tí ó sùn tó ní òún kú, tó bá jí, ta ni yó wìí fún?
english_literal: The person who is asleep but spreads the word that he or she is dead, when he or she awakens whom will he or she tell?
interpretation_gold: If one paints oneself into a corner one is truly stuck.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹni tí ó ṣe ojú kò da bí ẹni tó ṣe ẹ̀hìn.
english_literal: The person who honors one in one's presence is nothing like the person who honors one in one's absence.
interpretation_gold: It is what people say of one, or what they do on one's behalf, in one's absence that matters.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹ̀wà yí kò dùn, ẹ̀wà yí kò dùn, àáṣó ìpàkọ́ ḿmì tìtì.
english_literal: These beans are not delicious, these beans are not delicious, yet the coiffure at the occiput is shaking vigorously.
interpretation_gold: A person's actions towards a person or thing belie his or her detracting comments; if one claims to dislike something or someone, one's actions should not say the opposite.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹ̀là lọ̀rọ̀; bóbìnrín bá jókòó a laṣọ bòbò.
english_literal: Statements must always be clarified; when a woman sits she covers her genitals with her wrapper.
interpretation_gold: One must always be clear in one's speeches or intentions. This is a variant of the preceding entry.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ṣìgìdì ò lẹ́nu fọhùn; irọ́ ńpurọ́ fúnrọ́.
english_literal: The earthen idol has no mouth to speak; lies are lying to lies.
interpretation_gold: One should not be fooled by people who, for example, offer to reveal one's future to one.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ọbẹ̀-ẹ́ dùn, ọbẹ̀ ò dùn, iyán tán nígbá.
english_literal: The stew is delicious, the stew is not delicious; the pounded yams meal is completely gone from the dish.
interpretation_gold: Said of people who complain about something yet will not let go of it.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ṣìgìdì tí ò sọ̀rọ̀, a ò mẹni tí ńgbè.
english_literal: The earthen idol that does not speak, no one knows whose side it is on.
interpretation_gold: If one is cagey, no one can ascribe any position to one.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹni tí ó gbépo lájà ò jalè bí ẹni tó gbà á sílẹ̀ fún un.
english_literal: The person who removes oil from the rafter is less a thief than the person who helps him set it on the floor.
interpretation_gold: The abettor is more a culprit than the perpetrator.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ọ̀kánkán là ńṣe ìbí; ìkọ̀kọ̀ là ńṣe ìmùlẹ̀; bí a tọ́jú ìmùlẹ̀ tán, ká tọ́jú ìbí pẹ̀lú; bí a bá kú ará ẹni ní ńsinni.
english_literal: One conducts affairs with one's kin with forthrightness; one enters into covenants (with non-relatives) in secret; as one attends to one's secret compacts, one should also attend to affairs with one's kin; on the day one dies it is one's kin who attend to one's funeral.
interpretation_gold: Never neglect your kin in favor of others.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹni tí ó bá mọ ìṣe òkùnkùn, kó má dàá òṣùpá lóró; ohun a ṣe ní ńmúni-í rìnde òru; òkùnkùn ò yẹ ọmọ èèyàn.
english_literal: Whoever knows what darkness can do must not antagonize the moon; one's actions “sometimes” send one abroad at night; roaming around in the dark is not a becoming habit.
interpretation_gold: It is best to cultivate those forces that might serve one well in the future.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹnu-u rẹ̀ ní ńdá igba, tí ńdá ọ̀ọ́dúnrún.
english_literal: His or her mouth is the same one that proposes two hundred and proposes three hundred.
interpretation_gold: An unreliable person's mouth is ever running, and what comes out of it is not to be trusted.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ọ̀rọ̀ ò pariwo.
english_literal: The matter in question does not make a noise.
interpretation_gold: The matter under discussion poses little problem.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹni tí a nà ní kùm̀mọ̀ mẹ́fà, tó ní ọ̀kan ṣoṣo ló ba òun, níbo nìyókùú sọnù sí?
english_literal: A person who is hit six times with a club and says only one blow landed; where did the other blows disappear to?
interpretation_gold: A person who tries to minimize his or her obvious misfortune deceives no one.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹ-kòì-fẹ́-mi-kù, tó ta ajá-a rẹ̀ lókòó.
english_literal: You-have-not-seen-the-last-of-me, who sold his dog for twenty cowries.
interpretation_gold: A person duped without his or her knowledge will be back for redress once the fact dawns on him or her.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹ̀tàn kì í ṣe ọgbọ́n.
english_literal: Deceit is no wisdom.
interpretation_gold: Deceit is not a reliable strategy to count on.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹran tí a kì í jẹ, a kì í fi ehín pín in.
english_literal: Meat that one does not eat, one does not bite into allotments with one's teeth.
interpretation_gold: One should be unequivocal in one's commitments or avoidances.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: “Ọ̀ràn yí ò dùn mí”: ẹ̀ẹ̀kanṣoṣo là ńwí i.
english_literal: “This matter does not hurt me”: stating it only once suffices.
interpretation_gold: If one is indifferent to something, it should not dominate one's conversations.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹnìkan kì í yọ̀ kí ilẹ̀ ó sẹ́.
english_literal: When a person slips, the earth may not deny responsibility or knowledge.
interpretation_gold: For whatever one does, one should be willing to accept responsibility.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹ̀ẹ̀mejì letí ọlọ́jà ńgbọ́rọ̀.
english_literal: The ears of the king hear everything twice.
interpretation_gold: Whoever will judge a case must hear it twice from both sides of the dispute.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹyẹlé ní òun ò lè bá olúwa òun jẹ, kí òun bá a mu, kí ó di ọjọ́ ikú-u rẹ̀ kí òun yẹrí.
english_literal: The pigeon says it cannot share its owner's food and drink, and then, when the day of his death arrives, duck its head.
interpretation_gold: If one shares the good times with a person, one should be prepared to share the bad times also.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹlẹ́rìí ní ńyanjú ẹjọ́; ẹlẹ́rìí kì í ṣe elégbè.
english_literal: It is a witness that clears up a case; a witness is not a partisan.
interpretation_gold: People called to bear witness in a case should be impartial.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹnu òpùrọ́ kì í ṣẹ̀jẹ̀.
english_literal: The liar's mouth does not bleed.
interpretation_gold: Lies have no tell-tale labels attached to them.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹni tí ó fẹ́ kúure, kó hùwà rere.
english_literal: Whoever wishes to die a decent death, let him or her live decently.
interpretation_gold: As one lives, so one dies, and so one is remembered.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ọ̀nà irọ́ kì í pẹ́ẹ́ pin.
english_literal: The path of deceit soon ends.
interpretation_gold: Deceit is soon exposed.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ọ̀tá ẹni kì í pòdù ọ̀yà.
english_literal: One's enemy never kills a huge cane-rat.
interpretation_gold: One is always tempted to minimize the accomplishments of one's enemies.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹni a kò fẹ́ nilé-e rẹ̀ ńjìnna lójú ẹni.
english_literal: It is a person one does not love whose house is distant in one's estimation.
interpretation_gold: One can always find an excuse for not doing what one does not wish to do.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹni tí ó gbọ́n tó ńpurọ́; ẹni tó mọ̀ràn tó ńṣèké; ẹni tó mọ̀ pé nǹkan ò sí tó ńtọrọ; èwo ló sàn nínú àwọn mẹ́tẹ̀ẹ̀ta?
english_literal: The person who is wise and yet lies, the person who knows the truth and yet dissembles, the person who knows one has nothing and yet asks something of one, which is any good among the three?
interpretation_gold: The liar, the dissembler, and the one who would embarrass one, are all equally evil.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ọ̀rọ̀ ìkọ̀kọ̀, ní gba-n-gba ní ḿbọ̀.
english_literal: Secret matters have open exposure as their ultimate destination.
interpretation_gold: Whatever is done in secret will eventually be exposed.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹni tí ó sá là ńlé.
english_literal: People chase only those who flee.
interpretation_gold: Those who act as though they are guilty are the ones presumed to be guilty.

part_theme: consistency; honesty, openness, plain speaking, reliability
yoruba: Ẹní bá sùn là ńjí, a kì í jí apirọrọ.
english_literal: One wakes only those that sleep; one does not wake those pretending to sleep.
interpretation_gold: One should deal with people who are in earnest, not with gamesters.

yoruba: A-láì-mète-mèrò ọkọ tó fi adìẹ ìyàwó bọ orí ìyálé; bí baálé bá jẹ́ ìkà, èwo ni tòrìṣà?
english_literal: The shiftless, thoughtless husband who makes the junior wife's chicken as a sacrifice to the senior wife's head; if the husband is wicked, what about the god?
interpretation_gold: God will not accept offerings or prayers tainted with wickedness.

yoruba: Àṣírí-i náwó-náwó kì í tú lójú ahun.
english_literal: The big spender is never disgraced in the presence of the miser.
interpretation_gold: The free spender will always be honored in the community.

yoruba: A-fi-tirẹ̀-sílẹ̀-gbọ́-tẹniẹlẹ́ni, Ọlọ́run ní ḿba gbọ́ tirẹ̀.
english_literal: He-who-neglects-his-affairs-to-care-for-others'-affairs, it is God that takes care of his affairs.
interpretation_gold: God takes care of the benevolent.

yoruba: Abúni ò tó abẹ̀rín; bẹ́ẹ̀ni abẹ̀rín ò mọ ẹ̀hìn ọ̀la.
english_literal: The person who insults one is not as bad as the person who derides one; yet the person who derides one does not know what the future may bring.
interpretation_gold: Fortunes and circumstances may be reversed in time.

yoruba: A kì í fi àìmọ̀nà dá pàdé-m̀-pàdé.
english_literal: One does not play the rendezvous game without knowing one's way.
interpretation_gold: One should not enter into competition handicapped by ignorance.

yoruba: Ayídóborí tafà sókè: ojú Olúwaá tó wọn.
english_literal: Those who cover their heads with mortars and shoot arrows into the sky: God's eyes encompass them all.
interpretation_gold: God sees all acts of selfishness and wickedness towards others.

yoruba: A-lágbára-má-mèrò, baba ọ̀lẹ́.
english_literal: He-who-has-strength-but-lacks-discretion, father of laziness.
interpretation_gold: A powerful but thoughtless person is worse than the laziest person.

yoruba: Àìmète, àìmèrò, lọmọ ìyá mẹ́fà-á fi ńkú sóko ẹgbàafà.
english_literal: Lack of resourcefulness and lack of thoughtfulness cause six siblings to die as pawns for only twelve thousand cowries.
interpretation_gold: Pooling resources and wisdom ensures better results than going it alone.

yoruba: Adìẹ́ yẹ̀gẹ̀, a ṣe bí ó ṣubú.
english_literal: The chicken lists to one side, we think it has fallen.
interpretation_gold: Never be too quick to celebrate the demise of a nemesis.

yoruba: Àì-fi-ǹ-kan-pe-ǹ-kan ní ḿba ǹ-kan jẹ́.
english_literal: It is failure-to-count-anything-as-significant that ruins things.
interpretation_gold: Minimizing problems results in disasters.

yoruba: Akẹ́yinjẹ ò mọ̀ pé ìdí ńro adìẹ.
english_literal: The person who gathers eggs to eat does not know that the chicken's orifice hurts.
interpretation_gold: One should never be so preoccupied with one's own pleasures that one does not care what they cost others.

yoruba: Àgbò ò ṣéé mú; ọ̀dá ò ṣéé mú; ohun gbogbo ní ńtóbi lójú ahun.
